title_en: Sample from What You See: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Diffusion Bridge with Observation-Embedded Stochastic Differential Equation
title_zh: 从你所见中采样：通过带观测嵌入随机微分方程的扩散桥进行视觉运动策略学习

sentences.en: Imitation learning with diffusion models has advanced robotic control by capturing the multi-modal action distributions.
sentences.zh: 基于扩散模型的模仿学习通过捕捉多模态的动作分布，推动了机器人控制的发展。

sentences.en: However, existing methods typically treat observations only as high-level conditions to the denoising network, rather than integrating them into the stochastic dynamics of the diffusion process itself.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法通常仅将观测视为去噪网络的高层条件，而没有将其整合到扩散过程本身的随机动态中。

sentences.en: As a result, the sampling is forced to begin from random noise, weakening the coupling between perception and control and often yielding suboptimal performance.
sentences.zh: 因此，采样被迫从随机噪声开始，削弱了感知与控制之间的耦合，且往往产生次优的性能。

sentences.en: We propose BridgePolicy, a generative visuomotor policy that directly integrates observations into the stochastic dynamics via a diffusion-bridge formulation.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 BridgePolicy，一种生成式视觉运动策略，它通过扩散桥的公式化方法将观测直接整合到随机动态中。

sentences.en: By constructing an observation-informed trajectory, BridgePolicy enables sampling to start from a rich and informative prior rather than random noise, substantially improving precision and reliability in control.
sentences.zh: 通过构建一个受观测信息引导的轨迹，BridgePolicy 使采样能够从丰富且信息量大的先验开始，而非随机噪声，从而大幅提升控制的精度和可靠性。

sentences.en: A key difficulty is that diffusion bridge normally connects distributions of matched dimensionality, while robotic observations are heterogeneous and not naturally aligned with actions.
sentences.zh: 一个关键难点在于，扩散桥通常连接维度匹配的分布，而机器人观测是异构的，与动作并非自然对齐。

sentences.en: To overcome this, we introduce a semantic aligner to unify the visual and state inputs and align the observations with action representations, making diffusion bridge applicable to heterogeneous robot data.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一难点，我们引入一个语义对齐器来统一视觉和状态输入，并将观测与动作表示对齐，从而使扩散桥适用于异构的机器人数据。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across 52 simulation tasks on three benchmarks and 5 real-world tasks demonstrate that BridgePolicy consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative policies.
sentences.zh: 在三个基准上的 52 个仿真任务以及 5 个真实世界任务上的大量实验表明，BridgePolicy 持续优于最先进的生成式策略。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/jianghcsr/BridgePolicy.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/jianghcsr/BridgePolicy 获取。

title_en: Sample Margin-Aware Recalibration of Temperature Scaling
title_zh: 样本间隔感知的温度缩放重校准

sentences.en: Deep neural networks frequently exhibit overconfidence, undermining reliability in safety-critical applications.
sentences.zh: 深度神经网络经常表现出过度自信，这会削弱安全关键应用中的可靠性。

sentences.en: Existing adaptive methods rely on indirectly learned proxies of sample difficulty.
sentences.zh: 现有的自适应方法依赖于间接学习得到的样本难度代理。

sentences.en: We establish the logit margin as a direct and principled hardness indicator.
sentences.zh: 我们将 logit 间隔确立为一种直接且原则性的难度指标。

sentences.en: We prove that margin constrains the feasible temperature range for a target confidence.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，间隔约束了达到目标置信度时可行的温度范围。

sentences.en: Empirically, margin strongly correlates with decision boundary proximity and reveals systematic calibration patterns across difficulty levels.
sentences.zh: 实验上，间隔与决策边界邻近度强相关，并揭示出不同难度水平下的系统性校准模式。

sentences.en: We further identify a fundamental flaw in NLL-based optimization: minimizing NLL can paradoxically worsen calibration.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步发现了基于 NLL 的优化的一个根本缺陷：最小化 NLL 反而可能使校准更差。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce Charbonnier-SoftECE, a smooth objective that provably upper-bounds the smooth calibration error (smCE).
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出 Charbonnier-SoftECE，一个平滑的目标函数，它可证明地给出平滑校准误差（smCE）的上界。

sentences.en: Building on these insights, we propose SMART (Sample Margin-Aware Recalibration of Temperature), a lightweight method that learns a sample-wise margin-to-temperature mapping guided by our calibration-centric objective.
sentences.zh: 基于这些洞见，我们提出 SMART（样本间隔感知的温度重校准），一种轻量级方法，它在以校准为中心的客观目标的引导下，学习逐样本的间隔到温度的映射。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art calibration across CNNs and ViTs on standard, long-tailed, and distribution-shifted benchmarks, with minimal inference-time overhead.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，在标准、长尾和分布偏移基准上，该方法在 CNN 和 ViT 上实现了最先进的校准性能，且推理时开销极小。

sentences.en: Code is available at: https://github.com/Misakaaaaaz/ICML2026-SMART.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/Misakaaaaaz/ICML2026-SMART 获取。

title_en: Sample-Efficient Diffusion-based Reinforcement Learning with Critic Guidance
title_zh: 带评论家引导的样本高效扩散强化学习

sentences.en: Recent advances in reinforcement learning (RL) have achieved great successes by leveraging the multimodality and exploration capability of diffusion policies.
sentences.zh: 强化学习（RL）的近期进展通过利用扩散策略的多模态性和探索能力取得了巨大成功。

sentences.en: Among these approaches, one representative branch focuses on the sampling-based policy optimization.
sentences.zh: 在这些方法中，一个具有代表性的分支专注于基于采样的策略优化。

sentences.en: This design enables better exploration capability of the diffusion model, particularly at the beginning of training, but suffer from low exploitation in Q-value information, resulting in a slow policy convergence.
sentences.zh: 这种设计使扩散模型拥有更好的探索能力（尤其是在训练初期），但在利用 Q 值信息方面效率较低，导致策略收敛缓慢。

sentences.en: Another branch pays attention to gradient-based policy optimization, which sufficiently exploits the gradient of the Q function yet tends to collapse into a unimodal policy with low diversity.
sentences.zh: 另一个分支则关注基于梯度的策略优化，它充分利用了 Q 函数的梯度，但往往塌缩为多样性较低的单峰策略。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose CGPO, \textbf{C}ritic-\textbf{G}uided diffusion \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization, which effectively balances exploration and exploitation with the training-free guidance technique integrated into the denoising process of diffusion policy.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出 CGPO（\textbf{C}ritic-\textbf{G}uided diffusion \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization，评论家引导的扩散策略优化），它将免训练的引导技术整合到扩散策略的去噪过程中，从而有效地平衡探索与利用。

sentences.en: Concretely, CGPO steers action generation toward high-value regions defined by the critic network and uses the guided actions as regression objectives.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，CGPO 将动作生成引向由评论家网络定义的高价值区域，并将引导后的动作作为回归目标。

sentences.en: In this manner, CGPO reduces the time required to obtain high-quality actions and improves final performance with better balance between the exploration-exploitation tradeoff.
sentences.zh: 通过这种方式，CGPO 缩短了获得高质量动作所需的时间，并在探索–利用权衡之间取得更好的平衡，从而提升最终性能。

sentences.en: We validate the effectiveness of CGPO on 5 MuJoCo locomotion tasks, and CGPO achieves state-of-the-art performance compared with existing diffusion-based RL methods.
sentences.zh: 我们在 5 个 MuJoCo 运动任务上验证了 CGPO 的有效性，与现有的基于扩散的 RL 方法相比，CGPO 取得了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: Notably, CGPO is the first success to incorporate diffusion policy into real-world RL, with its superior performance on Franka robot arm grasping tasks.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，CGPO 是首个成功将扩散策略引入真实世界 RL 的方法，在 Franka 机械臂抓取任务上表现出优越性能。

sentences.en: Our official page is released at \url{https://dingsht.tech/cgpo-webpage}.
sentences.zh: 我们的官方页面已发布于 \url{https://dingsht.tech/cgpo-webpage}。

title_en: Sampling and Identity-Testing Without Approximate Tensorization of Entropy
title_zh: 无熵近似张量化条件下的采样与恒等性检验

sentences.en: We study the problems of approximate sampling from and distribution testing of \emph{mixture models}, where the modes satisfy a functional inequality called \emph{approximate tensorization of entropy} (ATE). While it is known that ATE makes these tasks more efficient in the unimodal setting, mixtures of few distributions satisfying ATE do not necessarily satisfy ATE overall, leading to a lack of theoretical guarantees for multimodal distributions, which are a key challenging case of modern generative models.
sentences.zh: 我们研究 \emph{混合模型} 的近似采样与分布检验问题，其中各模式满足一个称为 \emph{熵的近似张量化}（approximate tensorization of entropy，ATE）的函数不等式。众所周知，在单峰设置下 ATE 会使这些任务更高效，但满足 ATE 的少数分布的混合并不必然整体满足 ATE，这导致多峰分布在理论上缺乏保证，而多峰分布正是现代生成模型的一个关键难点情形。

sentences.en: We show this gap can be overcome by establishing the following pair of results for mixtures of ATE distributions:  1) We show fast mixing of Glauber dynamics from a \emph{data-based          initialization}, with \emph{optimal} sample complexity, for mixtures of distributions satisfying modified log-Sobolev inequalities, building on similar results in (Koehler et al., 2024, Huang et al., 2024) for mixtures satisfying the weaker Poincaré inequality.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，通过为 ATE 分布的混合建立下面一对结果，可以克服这一差距：1) 对于满足修正对数 Sobolev 不等式的分布混合，我们证明从 \emph{基于数据的初始化} 出发的 Glauber 动态具有快速混合，且样本复杂度 \emph{最优}；这建立在 (Koehler et al., 2024, Huang et al., 2024) 中针对满足较弱 Poincaré 不等式的混合分布的类似结果之上。

sentences.en: 2) Answering an open question from (Blanca et al., 2023), we give efficient identity-testers for mixtures of ATE distributions in the coordinate-conditional sampling access model.
sentences.zh: 2) 回答 (Blanca et al., 2023) 提出的一个开放问题，我们在坐标条件采样访问模型下为 ATE 分布的混合给出了高效的恒同性检验器。

title_en: Sampling from Your Language Model One Byte at a Time
title_zh: 逐字节地从你的语言模型中采样

sentences.en: Tokenization is used almost universally by modern language models, enabling efficient text representation using multi-byte or multi-character tokens.
sentences.zh: 分词（tokenization）几乎普遍被现代语言模型采用，它通过使用多字节或多字符的 token 实现高效的文本表示。

sentences.en: However, prior work has shown that tokenization can introduce distortion into the model's generations, an issue known as the Prompt Boundary Problem (PBP).
sentences.zh: 然而，先前的工作表明，分词会给模型的生成内容引入失真，这个问题被称为提示边界问题（Prompt Boundary Problem，PBP）。

sentences.en: For example, users are often advised not to end their prompts with a space because it prevents the model from including the space as part of the next token.
sentences.zh: 例如，用户常常被建议不要在提示的末尾加上空格，因为这会阻止模型将空格作为下一个 token 的一部分。

sentences.en: While this heuristic is effective in English, the underlying PBP continues to affect code generation and languages such as Chinese, where tokens often do not line up with word and syntactic boundaries.
sentences.zh: 虽然这种启发式方法在英语中有效，但底层的 PBP 仍会继续影响代码生成以及中文等语言，在这些场景中 token 往往与词和句法边界不吻合。

sentences.en: In this work, we present an inference-time method to convert any autoregressive LM with a BPE tokenizer into a character-level or byte-level LM.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出一种推理时方法，可将任何带有 BPE 分词器的自回归 LM 转换为字符级或字节级 LM。

sentences.en: Our method efficiently solves the PBP and is also able to unify the vocabularies of language models with different tokenizers, allowing one to ensemble LMs with different tokenizers at inference time or transfer the post-training from one model to another using proxy-tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法能高效地解决 PBP，还能统一具有不同分词器的语言模型的词汇表，从而允许用户在推理时集成具有不同分词器的 LM，或通过代理调优（proxy-tuning）将后训练结果从一个模型迁移到另一个模型。

title_en: SAMT: Generating Structured Avatar Meshes and Textures from a Single Image
title_zh: SAMT：从单张图像生成结构化的虚拟形象网格与纹理

sentences.en: Despite rapid progress in generative 3D creation, producing high-fidelity 3D face assets from a single image remains challenging, as it requires both identity-critical facial micro-structures and fine-grained view-consistent textures.
sentences.zh: 尽管生成式 3D 创作进展迅速，但从单张图像生成高保真的 3D 人脸资产仍然具有挑战性，因为它既需要身份关键的面部微结构，也需要细粒度的视图一致纹理。

sentences.en: To address this, we present a two-stage framework named **SAMT** for monocular 3D avatar generation and texture synthesis.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出一个名为 **SAMT** 的两阶段框架，用于单目 3D 虚拟形象生成和纹理合成。

sentences.en: Specifically, a latent 3D diffusion model for facial mesh generation is pretrained and then further adapted to generate high-quality facial geometry through large-scale domain-specific finetuning on 35K curated 3D avatar models.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们先预训练一个用于面部网格生成的潜在 3D 扩散模型，然后通过在 35K 个精选的 3D 虚拟形象模型上进行大规模领域特定微调，进一步调整它以生成高质量的面部几何。

sentences.en: Subsequently, the generated facial mesh is textured through a multi-view-aware texturing strategy.
sentences.zh: 随后，通过一种多视图感知的纹理化策略为生成的面部网格添加纹理。

sentences.en: It incorporates multi-view facial priors along with the mesh geometry to guide a 2D texturing diffusion, enabling cross-view consistent and mesh-aligned texture synthesis.
sentences.zh: 该策略将多视图面部先验与网格几何相结合，以引导 2D 纹理化扩散，从而实现跨视图一致且与网格对齐的纹理合成。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAMT improves over existing baselines by producing more coherent facial geometry together with more fine-grained and view-consistent textures.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，SAMT 通过生成更连贯的面部几何以及更细粒度、视图一致的纹理，优于现有的基线方法。

sentences.en: Project page is available at https://github.com/muyuWang/SAMT.
sentences.zh: 项目页面可在 https://github.com/muyuWang/SAMT 查看。

title_en: SAOT: Self-Supervised Continual Graph Learning with Structure-Aware Optimal Transport
title_zh: SAOT：具有结构感知最优传输的自监督持续图学习

sentences.en: Self-supervised Continual Graph Learning (CGL) aims to successively learn from a graph sequence with different tasks without label supervision—a paradigm that has attracted widespread attention.
sentences.zh: 自监督持续图学习（CGL）旨在没有标签监督的情况下，从具有不同任务的一系列图中依次学习——这是一种已引起广泛关注的范式。

sentences.en: Most existing self-supervised CGL methods rely on instance-level consistency objectives that enforce stability of individual node (or node-pair) embeddings.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有的自监督 CGL 方法依赖实例级的一致性目标，以强制保持单个节点（或节点对）嵌入的稳定性。

sentences.en: Due to optimizing nodes in isolation, these methods fail to maintain global relational structure, causing inter-node correspondences to progressively distort under continual learning.
sentences.zh: 由于孤立地优化节点，这些方法无法保持全局的关系结构，导致节点间的对应关系在持续学习下逐渐扭曲。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose a novel Structure-Aware Optimal Transport (SAOT) framework that explicitly captures and preserves relational structure within graph representations across sequential tasks.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出一个新的结构感知最优传输（SAOT）框架，它显式地捕获并保存在跨顺序任务的图表示中的关系结构。

sentences.en: Specifically, SAOT leverages optimal transport theory to capture global inter-node correspondences, thereby facilitating and enhancing graph representation learning.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，SAOT 利用最优传输理论来捕获全局的节点间对应关系，从而促进并增强图表示学习。

sentences.en: Simultaneously, SAOT incorporates a cross-task knowledge distillation mechanism to preserve the previous structural knowledge.
sentences.zh: 同时，SAOT 引入了一种跨任务知识蒸馏机制，以保留先前的结构知识。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on four CGL benchmark datasets demonstrate that SAOT outperforms existing self-supervised baselines.
sentences.zh: 在四个 CGL 基准数据集上的大量实验表明，SAOT 优于现有的自监督基线方法。

sentences.en: In particular, SAOT achieves significant performance gains, improving average accuracy by up to 5% on CoraFull-CL and over 15% on Products-CL compared with state-of-the-art methods in the Class-IL setting.
sentences.zh: 特别地，在 Class-IL 设置下，SAOT 相比最先进的方法取得了显著的性能提升：在 CoraFull-CL 上平均准确率最多提升 5%，在 Products-CL 上提升超过 15%。

title_en: SAQNN: Spectral Adaptive Quantum Neural Network as a Universal Approximator
title_zh: SAQNN：作为通用逼近器的谱自适应量子神经网络

sentences.en: Quantum machine learning (QML), as an interdisciplinary field bridging quantum computing and machine learning, has garnered significant attention in recent years.
sentences.zh: 量子机器学习（QML）作为连接量子计算与机器学习的交叉领域，近年来受到了广泛关注。

sentences.en: Currently, the field as a whole faces challenges due to incomplete theoretical foundations for the expressivity of quantum neural networks (QNNs).
sentences.zh: 目前，由于量子神经网络（QNN）表达能力的理论基础尚不完善，整个领域面临着挑战。

sentences.en: In this paper we propose a constructive QNN model and demonstrate that it possesses the universal approximation property (UAP), which means it can approximate any square-integrable function up to arbitrary accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一个构造性的 QNN 模型，并证明它具有通用逼近性（universal approximation property，UAP），即它可以逼近任意平方可积函数达到任意精度。

sentences.en: Furthermore, it supports switching function bases, thus adaptable to various scenarios in numerical approximation and machine learning.
sentences.zh: 此外，它支持切换函数基，因此可适应数值逼近和机器学习中的各种场景。

sentences.en: Our model has asymptotic advantages over the best classical feed-forward neural networks in terms of circuit size and achieves optimal parameter complexity when approximating Sobolev functions under $L_2$ norm.
sentences.zh: 在电路规模方面，我们的模型相比最优的经典前馈神经网络具有渐近优势，并且在 $L_2$ 范数下逼近 Sobolev 函数时实现了最优的参数复杂度。

title_en: SARL: Structure-Aligned Reinforcement Learning for Bridging the Perception-Action Gap in Airspace
title_zh: SARL：用于弥合空域感知–行动差距的结构对齐强化学习

sentences.en: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) has been widely applied to automated aircraft conflict resolution due to its strong capability for cooperative control and distributed decision-making.
sentences.zh: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）凭借其在协同控制和分布式决策方面的强大能力，已被广泛应用于自动化飞机冲突解脱。

sentences.en: However, existing approaches typically assume a fixed number of aircraft and neglect the unique characteristics of air traffic control instructions.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法通常假设飞机数量固定，并忽视了空中交通管制的独特特征。

sentences.en: This structural misalignment between model architectures and domain requirements leads to severe deficiencies in perception scalability and action stability across scenarios of varying scales.
sentences.zh: 模型架构与领域要求之间的这种结构错位，导致在不同规模场景下，感知可扩展性和动作稳定性存在严重不足。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose Structural-Aligned Reinforcement Learning (SARL), which aims to bridge the gap between perception and action.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些挑战，我们提出结构对齐强化学习（SARL），其目标是弥合感知与行动之间的差距。

sentences.en: First, the Physics-Encoded Relational Graph (PERG) effectively resolves the fixed input dimensionality issue by incorporating physical inductive biases into a graph attention mechanism.
sentences.zh: 首先，物理编码关系图（Physics-Encoded Relational Graph，PERG）通过将物理归纳偏置融入图注意力机制，有效解决了输入维度固定的问题。

sentences.en: Second, we design the Sparse Cognitive Mixture-of-Experts (SC-MoE) to enhance decision stability.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们设计稀疏认知专家混合模型（Sparse Cognitive Mixture-of-Experts，SC-MoE）以增强决策稳定性。

sentences.en: In addition, we introduce a Kinematic Kafety Shield (KSS) based on aviation rules, which not only improves inference-time safety but also effectively guides the model to generate semantically meaningful actions that comply with aviation standards.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入一个基于航空规则的运动学安全护盾（Kinematic Kafety Shield，KSS），它不仅提升了推理时的安全性，还能有效引导模型生成符合航空标准的、具有语义意义的动作。

sentences.en: Simulation experiment results demonstrate that SARL significantly outperforms existing reinforcement learning baselines across diverse scenarios in terms of both success rate and operational efficiency.
sentences.zh: 仿真实验结果表明，在多样化场景下，SARL 在成功率和运行效率两方面均显著优于现有的强化学习基线方法。

title_en: SARSteer: Safeguarding Large Audio Language Models via Safe-Ablated Refusal Steering
title_zh: SARSteer：通过安全消融的拒绝引导守护大型音频语言模型

sentences.en: Large Audio–Language Models (LALMs) are becoming essential as a powerful multimodal backbone for real-world applications.
sentences.zh: 大型音频–语言模型（LALM）正逐渐成为现实世界应用中强大的多模态骨干，变得不可或缺。

sentences.en: However, recent studies show that audio inputs can more easily elicit harmful responses than text, exposing new risks toward deployment.
sentences.zh: 然而，近期研究表明，音频输入比文本更容易引发有害响应，给部署带来了新的风险。

sentences.en: While safety alignment has made initial advances in LLMs and Large Vision–Language Models (LVLMs), we find that vanilla adaptation of these approaches to LALMs faces two key limitations: 1) LLM-based steering fails under audio input due to the large distributional gap between activations, and 2) prompt-based defenses induce over-refusals on benign-speech queries.
sentences.zh: 虽然安全对齐已在 LLM 和大型视觉–语言模型（LVLM）中取得初步进展，但我们发现，将这些方法朴素地迁移到 LALM 会面临两个关键局限：1) 基于 LLM 的引导在音频输入下会失效，因为激活之间存在较大的分布差距；2) 基于提示的防御会在良性语音查询上引发过度拒绝。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose **S**afe-**A**blated **R**efusal **Steer**ing (SARSteer), an effective inference-time defense framework for LALMs.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些挑战，我们提出 **S**afe-**A**blated **R**efusal **Steer**ing（SARSteer），一个面向 LALM 的有效推理时防御框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, SARSteer leverages text-derived refusal steering to enforce rejection without manipulating audio inputs and introduces decomposed safe-space ablation to mitigate over-refusal.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，SARSteer 利用源自文本的拒绝引导来强制拒绝，而无需操纵音频输入，并引入分解的安全空间消融以缓解过度拒绝。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that SARSteer significantly improves harmful-query refusal while preserving benign responses, establishing a principled step toward safety alignment in LALMs.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，SARSteer 在保持良性响应的同时，显著提升了对有害查询的拒绝能力，为 LALM 的安全对齐迈出了原则性的一步。

sentences.en: The codes and constructed datasets are released at https://github.com/linweiii/SARSteer.
sentences.zh: 代码和构造的数据集已发布于 https://github.com/linweiii/SARSteer。

title_en: SaTeen: Learning Structural Alignment for Continual Test-Time Adaptation
title_zh: SaTeen：为持续测试时适配学习结构对齐

sentences.en: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) aims to reconcile model generalization in the presence of distribution shifts.
sentences.zh: 测试时适配（TTA）旨在在存在分布偏移的情况下协调模型的泛化能力。

sentences.en: Current TTA methods usually leverage sample uncertainty to select reliable samples for model adjustment via entropy minimization (EM).
sentences.zh: 当前的 TTA 方法通常利用样本不确定性来选择可靠的样本，并通过熵最小化（EM）进行模型调整。

sentences.en: However, sample uncertainty often relies on a plausible metric and leaves many unreliable samples into EM process, potentially leading to model collapse.
sentences.zh: 然而，样本不确定性往往依赖于一种看似合理的度量，使得许多不可靠的样本进入 EM 过程，可能导致模型塌缩。

sentences.en: Importantly, these excluded samples incur biased data features of the shifted distribution in TTA.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，这些被排除的样本会在 TTA 中带来偏移分布的偏置数据特征。

sentences.en: This paper introduces SaTeen, a **S**tructural **A**lignment-based **Te**st-Tim**e** Adaptatio**n** method that performs two-fold aligning the structures of test samples with the reliable reference structures.
sentences.zh: 本文提出 SaTeen，一种 **S**tructural **A**lignment-based **Te**st-Tim**e** Adaptatio**n** 方法（即基于结构对齐的测试时适配），该方法将测试样本的结构与可靠的参考结构进行双重对齐。

sentences.en: Specifically, the two-fold alignments are 1) Intra-sample structure alignment, where SaTeen maximizes cross-entropy discrepancy between a sample (reference) and its structure-disrupted counterpart, with the assumption of stable dominant features;
sentences.zh: 具体而言，双重对齐包括：1) 样本内结构对齐，SaTeen 最大化一个样本（参考）与其结构被破坏的对应样本之间的交叉熵差异，其假设是主导特征保持稳定；

sentences.en: 2) Inter-sample structure alignment, where SaTeen minimizes the reconstruction error of test samples in the reference subspace spanned by the Incremental PCA on reliable samples, with the assumption of stale intrinsic data manifold.
sentences.zh: 2) 样本间结构对齐，SaTeen 在由基于可靠样本的增量 PCA 所张成的参考子空间中最小化测试样本的重构误差，其假设是内在数据流形保持不变。

sentences.en: Our extensive experiments demonstrate that SaTeen achieves the state-of-the-art performance across various scenarios for both TTA and continual TTA.
sentences.zh: 我们的大量实验表明，SaTeen 在 TTA 和持续 TTA 的多种场景下均取得了最先进的性能。

title_en: Saving Foundation Flow-Matching Priors for Inverse Problems
title_zh: 拯救逆问题中的基础流匹配先验

sentences.en: Foundation flow-matching (FM) models promise universal priors for solving inverse problems (IPs); yet today, they trail behind domain-specific and even untrained priors.
sentences.zh: 基础流匹配（FM）模型有望成为解决逆问题（IP）的通用先验；然而时至今日，它们仍落后于领域特定的先验，甚至不如未经过训练的（untrained）先验。

sentences.en: \emph{How can we unlock their potential?} We introduce FMPlug, a plug-in framework that redefines how foundation FMs are used in IPs.
sentences.zh: \emph{我们如何释放它们的潜力？}我们提出 FMPlug，一个重新定义基础 FM 在 IP 中使用方式的即插即用框架。

sentences.en: FMPlug combines an instance-guided, time-dependent warm-start strategy with sharp Gaussianity regularization, adding problem-specific guidance while preserving the Gaussian structures.
sentences.zh: FMPlug 将实例引导的、与时间相关的热启动策略与锐利高斯性正则化相结合，在保留高斯结构的同时加入问题特定的引导。

sentences.en: For evaluation, we consider both simple image restoration tasks and scientific IPs with a few similar samples---where the prohibitive cost of data collection and model training hinders the development of domain-specific generative models.
sentences.zh: 在评估中，我们既考虑了简单的图像复原任务，也考虑了仅有少量相似样本的科学 IP——在这些场景中，数据收集和模型训练的昂贵成本阻碍了领域特定生成模型的开发。

sentences.en: Our superior experimental results confirm the effectiveness of FMPlug.
sentences.zh: 我们优越的实验结果证实了 FMPlug 的有效性。

sentences.en: Overall, FMPlug paves the way for making foundation FM models practical, reusable priors for IPs, especially scientific ones with few similar samples.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，FMPlug 为将基础 FM 模型打造为实用、可复用的 IP 先验铺平了道路，尤其是针对仅有少量相似样本的科学 IP。

title_en: SC$^{2}$-WM: A Self-Correcting World Model with Closed-Loop Feedback for Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
title_zh: SC$^{2}$-WM：一种用于连续环境视觉-语言导航的带闭环反馈的自校正世界模型

sentences.en: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to make fine-grained navigation decisions under partial observability.
sentences.zh: 连续环境中的视觉–语言导航（VLN-CE）要求智能体在部分可观测性下做出细粒度的导航决策。

sentences.en: However, most existing methods rely on open-loop execution, lacking mechanisms to detect and correct internal state drift during inference.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有方法依赖开环执行，缺少在推理期间检测并校正内部状态漂移的机制。

sentences.en: We propose SC$^{2}$-WM, a self-correcting world model framework that introduces internal feedback for closed-loop decision making in VLN-CE.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 SC$^{2}$-WM，一个自校正世界模型框架，它为 VLN-CE 中的闭环决策引入了内部反馈。

sentences.en: Our method derives feedback from world-model foresight to perform state-level plan refinement before action execution.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法从世界模型的预判中导出反馈，以在动作执行之前进行状态级的计划精化。

sentences.en: To handle challenging scenarios, we further introduce conditional world-aware adaptation, which enables model-level correction by selectively updating the world model at test time when feedback indicates model capacity insufficiency.
sentences.zh: 为应对具有挑战性的场景，我们进一步引入条件式世界感知适配，当反馈表明模型容量不足时，在测试时选择性地更新世界模型，从而实现模型级的校正。

sentences.en: Experiments on standard VLN-CE benchmarks demonstrate improved navigation robustness and generalization.
sentences.zh: 在标准 VLN-CE 基准上的实验表明，导航的鲁棒性和泛化能力均得到提升。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/sunrise-ikun/SC2_WM.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/sunrise-ikun/SC2_WM 获取。

title_en: SC-FAGC: Size Constrained Fast Anchor-based Graph Clustering
title_zh: SC-FAGC：大小约束的快速锚点图聚类

sentences.en: Spectral clustering is hindered by its $O(n^{3})$ time complexity, and although anchor-based approximations reduce this to $O(nm^{2})$ ($m \ll n$), they often yield degenerate or unbalanced partitions in the absence of explicit cluster-size control.
sentences.zh: 谱聚类受其 $O(n^{3})$ 时间复杂度的制约，虽然基于锚点的近似方法可将其降至 $O(nm^{2})$（$m \ll n$），但在没有显式簇大小控制的情况下，这类方法往往会产生退化或不平衡的划分。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{SC-FAGC (Size-Constrained Fast Anchor Graph Clustering)}, a unified formulation that integrates entropy regularization and bilateral cardinality constraints within an anchor-based spectral clustering framework, enforcing user-specified lower and upper bounds on anchor-level cluster sizes to avoid trivial or highly unbalanced solutions.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一局限，我们提出 \textbf{SC-FAGC（大小约束的快速锚点图聚类）}，一种统一的公式化方法，将熵正则化与双边基数约束整合进基于锚点的谱聚类框架中，对锚点级簇大小施加用户指定的下界与上界，以避免平凡或高度不平衡的解。

sentences.en: To solve the resulting non-convex problem efficiently, we develop an \textbf{Iteratively Re-weighted (IRW)} optimization scheme that linearizes the objective and solves each subproblem via a \textbf{Double-Bounded Optimal Transport (DB-OT)} solver based on the \textbf{Sinkhorn--Knopp} algorithm, guaranteeing convergence while maintaining scalability.
sentences.zh: 为高效求解由此产生的非凸问题，我们开发了一种 \textbf{迭代重加权（IRW）} 优化方案，将目标函数线性化，并通过基于 \textbf{Sinkhorn--Knopp} 算法的 \textbf{双边界最优传输（DB-OT）} 求解器求解每个子问题，在保证收敛的同时维护可扩展性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that SC-FAGC consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance across six standard clustering metrics while strictly enforcing the prescribed anchor-level constraints.
sentences.zh: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，SC-FAGC 在严格施加所规定锚点级约束的同时，在六项标准聚类指标上持续取得最先进的性能。

sentences.en: Moreover, it induces effective data-level size control after label transmission, offering a principled and scalable solution for large-scale graph clustering with controllable partition structure.
sentences.zh: 此外，在标签传播之后，它还能在数据层面实现有效的规模控制，为具有可控划分结构的大规模图聚类提供了原则明确且可扩展的解决方案。

title_en: Scalable and Differentiable Point-Cloud Registration Using Maximum Mean Discrepancy
title_zh: 基于最大均值差异的可扩展且可微的点云配准

sentences.en: We present MMD-Reg, a novel correspondence-free approach to point-cloud registration that is differentiable and has linear computational complexity in the number of points.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 MMD-Reg，一种新颖的无对应点（correspondence-free）点云配准方法，它可微且计算复杂度关于点数呈线性。

sentences.en: We model registration as a nonlinear least-squares problem based on the Maximum Mean Discrepancy, approximated using random Fourier features.
sentences.zh: 我们将配准建模为一个基于最大均值差异（Maximum Mean Discrepancy，MMD）的非线性最小二乘问题，并使用随机傅里叶特征进行近似。

sentences.en: The resulting objective can be solved efficiently with standard methods such as Levenberg–Marquardt, and the solution is differentiable via the implicit function theorem.
sentences.zh: 由此得到的目标函数可用 Levenberg–Marquardt 等标准方法高效求解，且借助隐函数定理，该解是可微的。

sentences.en: This allows MMD-Reg to be used as a differentiable optimization layer within end-to-end trainable models, supporting registration under challenging conditions such as poor initial alignment and partial overlap.
sentences.zh: 这使得 MMD-Reg 可被用作端到端可训练模型中的可微优化层，支持在初始对齐较差、部分重叠等具有挑战性的条件下进行配准。

sentences.en: We demonstrate this Neural MMD-Reg formulation by integrating the layer with a set transformer, training the resulting model in supervised and unsupervised settings, and comparing its performance against recent learning-based methods.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将该层与 set transformer（集合变换器）集成、在有监督与无监督设置下训练所得模型，并将其性能与近期基于学习的方法进行比较，来演示这一 Neural MMD-Reg（神经 MMD-Reg）公式。

sentences.en: We also evaluate standalone MMD-Reg, comparing its accuracy and scalability against widely used non-learning-based registration methods.
sentences.zh: 我们还评估了独立的 MMD-Reg，将其精度与可扩展性与广泛使用的非基于学习的配准方法进行比较。

title_en: Scalable and General Whole-Body Control for Cross-Humanoid Locomotion
title_zh: 面向跨人形机器人运动的可扩展且通用的全身控制

sentences.en: Learning-based whole-body controllers have become a key driver for humanoid robots, yet most existing approaches require robot-specific training.
sentences.zh: 基于学习的全身控制器已成为人形机器人的关键推动力，然而现有的多数方法都需要针对特定机器人进行训练。

sentences.en: In this paper, we study the problem of cross-embodiment humanoid control and show that a single policy can robustly generalize across a wide range of humanoid robot designs with one-time training.
sentences.zh: 本文研究跨本体（cross-embodiment）人形控制问题，并表明单一策略在一次训练后即可在广泛的人形机器人设计上稳健地泛化。

sentences.en: We introduce XHugWBC, a novel cross-embodiment training framework that enables generalist humanoid control through: (1) physics-consistent morphological randomization, (2) semantically aligned observation and action spaces across diverse humanoid robots, and (3) effective policy architectures modeling morphological and dynamical properties.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 XHugWBC，一种新颖的跨本体训练框架，通过以下三点实现通才式（generalist）人形控制：（1）物理一致的形态随机化；（2）跨多样人形机器人的语义对齐的观测与动作空间；（3）对形态与动力学属性进行建模的有效策略架构。

sentences.en: XHugWBC is not tied to any specific robot.
sentences.zh: XHugWBC 不绑定于任何特定机器人。

sentences.en: Instead, it internalizes a broad distribution of morphological and dynamical characteristics during training.
sentences.zh: 相反，它在训练过程中内化了广泛分布的形态与动力学特征。

sentences.en: By learning motion priors from diverse randomized embodiments, the policy acquires a strong structural bias that supports zero-shot transfer to previously unseen robots.
sentences.zh: 通过从多样随机化本体中学习运动先验，该策略获得了强大的结构先验偏差，从而支持对先前未见机器人进行零样本迁移。

sentences.en: Experiments on twelve simulated humanoids and seven real-world robots demonstrate the strong generalization and robustness of the resulting universal controller.
sentences.zh: 在十二个仿真人形机器人和七个真实机器人上的实验表明，由此得到的通用控制器具有很强的泛化能力与鲁棒性。

title_en: Scalable and Interpretable Representation Alignment with Ordinal Similarity
title_zh: 基于序数相似度的可扩展且可解释的表示对齐

sentences.en: Evaluating representation similarity is fundamental to representation learning.
sentences.zh: 评估表示相似度是表示学习的基础。

sentences.en: However, existing metrics suffer from significant limitations: they lack interpretability due to shifting baselines, lack robustness to outliers, and are computationally intractable for large datasets, forcing reliance on heuristic approximations.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有指标存在显著局限：由于基准线不断漂移（shifting baselines）而缺乏可解释性，对离群值缺乏鲁棒性，且在大规模数据集上计算上难以处理，迫使人们依赖启发式近似。

sentences.en: To address this, we develop an ordinal-similarity framework, instantiated by the Triplet (TSI) and Quadruplet (QSI) Similarity Indices, which measure alignment by quantifying the consistency of ordinal relationships.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出一个序数相似度框架，以三元组相似度指数（Triplet Similarity Index，TSI）和四元组相似度指数（Quadruplet Similarity Index，QSI）为实例，通过量化序数关系的一致性来衡量对齐程度。

sentences.en: We theoretically demonstrate this formulation is inherently interpretable, robust to outliers, and computationally efficient.
sentences.zh: 我们从理论上证明，这一公式本质上具有可解释性、对离群值鲁棒且计算高效。

sentences.en: Finally, we establish a formal equivalence between TSI and local neighborhood alignment, measured by Mutual Nearest Neighbors.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们建立了 TSI 与由互近邻（Mutual Nearest Neighbors）度量的局部邻域对齐之间的形式等价关系。

sentences.en: Empirically, we validate these properties and show that ordinal similarity offers a scalable approach to measuring alignment, enabling practitioners to better understand and design representations.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，我们验证了这些性质，并表明序数相似度提供了一种可扩展的衡量对齐程度的方法，使实践者能够更好地理解与设计表示。

title_en: Scalable and Stable Estimation of Amari $\alpha$-Divergence using Random Fourier Features
title_zh: 使用随机傅里叶特征对 Amari $\alpha$-散度进行可扩展且稳定的估计

sentences.en: Reliable estimation of Amari $\alpha$-divergences underpins variational inference, yet unconstrained neural critics are notoriously prone to instability.
sentences.zh: 对 Amari $\alpha$-散度的可靠估计是变分推断的基础，然而无约束的神经评判器（neural critic）以容易出现不稳定而著称。

sentences.en: We propose a scalable estimator by constraining the critic to a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS) ball and approximating the kernel via band-limited Random Fourier Features (RFF).
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种可扩展的估计器：将评判器约束在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）球内，并通过带限随机傅里叶特征（RFF）近似核。

sentences.en: This formulation yields a linear-time objective amenable to mini-batch stochastic optimization while avoiding the cubic complexity of Gram-matrix methods.
sentences.zh: 这一公式得到线性时间的目标函数，适合小批量随机优化，同时避免了 Gram 矩阵方法的立方复杂度。

sentences.en: We present a unified analysis based on a four-term error decomposition—comprising RKHS approximation, feature discretization, statistical deviation, and optimization residual.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种基于四项误差分解的统一分析——包括 RKHS 逼近、特征离散化、统计偏差与优化残差。

sentences.en: Under a spectral source condition, we derive non-asymptotic bounds establishing that the RKHS approximation bias scales as $\mathcal{O}(R^{-\gamma})$, the RFF discretization error as $\mathcal{O}(R D^{-1/2})$, and the statistical error as $\mathcal{O}(R n^{-1/2})$.
sentences.zh: 在谱源条件（spectral source condition）下，我们推导出非渐近界，确立了 RKHS 近似偏差以 $\mathcal{O}(R^{-\gamma})$ 的阶增长、RFF 离散化误差以 $\mathcal{O}(R D^{-1/2})$ 的阶增长、统计误差以 $\mathcal{O}(R n^{-1/2})$ 的阶增长。

sentences.en: We further show that statistical non-degeneracy induces intrinsic local curvature, enabling our proposed Armijo-SGD to achieve local linear convergence.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步表明，统计非退化性会引入内在的局部曲率，使我们提出的 Armijo-SGD 能够实现局部线性收敛。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluations demonstrate that the RFF-RKHS estimator outperforms varying-representation baselines in stability, and applying this spectral regularization to GAN critics significantly enhances the capture of high-frequency data components.
sentences.zh: 实验评估表明，RFF-RKHS 估计器在稳定性上优于多种不同表示的基线，且将此谱正则化应用于 GAN 评判器可显著增强对高频数据分量的捕捉。

title_en: Scalable Bayesian Inference for Nonlinear Conservation Laws
title_zh: 非线性守恒律的可扩展贝叶斯推断

sentences.en: Nonlinear conservation laws are at the heart of many of the most important dynamical systems in science and engineering.
sentences.zh: 非线性守恒律是科学与工程中许多最重要动力系统的核心。

sentences.en: In practical applications, such systems are often subject to various sources of uncertainty, e.g. due to sparse or noisy measurements.
sentences.zh: 在实际应用中，此类系统往往面临多种不确定性来源，例如由于测量稀疏或含噪。

sentences.en: Inferring physical quantities and fields of interest then becomes an ill-posed problem which both classical numerical methods and modern deep learning-based methods struggle to treat appropriately.
sentences.zh: 此时，推断感兴趣的物理量与场就成为一个不适定（ill-posed）问题，无论是经典数值方法还是基于深度学习的现代方法都难以恰当地处理。

sentences.en: Recent work has framed classical numerical methods as Bayesian inference under Gaussian process priors, resulting in a physics-aware treatment of uncertainties.
sentences.zh: 近期的研究将经典数值方法表述为高斯过程先验下的贝叶斯推断，从而实现了对不确定性的物理感知处理。

sentences.en: Following this line of work, we develop a novel numerically conservative method for uncertainty-aware simulations of nonlinear conservation laws.
sentences.zh: 沿着这一思路，我们开发了一种新颖的数值守恒方法，用于非线性守恒律的不确定性感知模拟。

sentences.en: We use recent sparse approximation techniques to scale up to large-scale forward and inverse problems.
sentences.zh: 我们利用近期的稀疏近似技术，将其扩展到大规模正问题与反问题。

sentences.en: For forward simulation, we inherit the accuracy of classical solvers while providing structured uncertainty quantification.
sentences.zh: 对于正演模拟，在提供结构化的不确定性量化的同时，我们继承了经典求解器的精度。

sentences.en: On inverse problems, we recover posteriors over nonparametric source fields in seconds --- outperforming neural baselines that take minutes to produce a less accurate point estimate.
sentences.zh: 对于反问题，我们可在数秒内恢复非参数源场上的后验——优于需要数分钟才能给出精度较低的点估计的神经基线。

title_en: Scalable Event Cloud Network for Event-based Classification
title_zh: 用于基于事件的分类的可扩展事件云网络

sentences.en: Event cameras are biologically inspired sensors garnering significant attention from both industry and academia.
sentences.zh: 事件相机（event camera）是受生物启发的传感器，在工业界和学术界都获得了广泛关注。

sentences.en: Mainstream methods favor frame and voxel representations, which reach a satisfactory performance while introducing time-consuming transformations, bulky models, and sacrificing fine-grained temporal information.
sentences.zh: 主流方法偏好帧与体素表示，它们虽然能达到令人满意的性能，但引入了耗时的变换、庞大的模型，并牺牲了细粒度的时间信息。

sentences.en: Alternatively, Point Cloud representation demonstrates promise in addressing the mentioned weaknesses, but it has limited scalability in abstracting features of higher spatial resolution and longer temporal sequence events.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，点云表示在应对上述弱点方面展现出潜力，但在抽象更高空间分辨率和更长时序事件的特征方面，其可扩展性有限。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a \textbf{S}calable \textbf{N}etwork named SECNet to leverage \textbf{E}vent \textbf{C}loud representation.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一个名为 SECNet 的可扩展网络，以利用 \textbf{E}vent \textbf{C}loud（事件云）表示。

sentences.en: SECNet integrates polarity at the structural level by innovating the Event-based Group and Sampling module rather than only at the input level.
sentences.zh: SECNet 通过创新性地设计基于事件的组与采样模块，在结构层面而非仅在输入层面整合极性（polarity）。

sentences.en: To accommodate the surge in the number of events, SECNet embraces feature extraction in the frequency domain via the Fourier transform.
sentences.zh: 为应对事件数量的激增，SECNet 采用傅里叶变换在频域中进行特征提取。

sentences.en: This approach not only substantially extinguishes the explosion of Multiply Accumulate Operations but also effectively abstracts spatio-temporal features.
sentences.zh: 该方法不仅大幅消除了乘累加运算（Multiply Accumulate Operations）的爆炸式增长，还能有效抽象时空特征。

sentences.en: We conducted extensive experiments on \textbf{ten} event-based datasets, and substantiate the scalability, effectiveness, and efficiency of SECNet.
sentences.zh: 我们在 \textbf{十}个基于事件的数据集上进行了大量实验，证实了 SECNet 的可扩展性、有效性与高效性。

title_en: Scalable GANs with Transformers
title_zh: 使用 Transformer 的可扩展生成对抗网络

sentences.en: Scalability has driven recent advances in generative modeling, yet it remains underexplored for adversarial learning.
sentences.zh: 可扩展性推动了生成式建模近期的进展，然而它在对抗学习方面仍未被充分探索。

sentences.en: We study the scaling behavior of Generative Adversarial Networks through two design choices: training in a compact Variational Autoencoder latent space and using purely transformer-based generators and discriminators.
sentences.zh: 我们通过两个设计选择来研究生成对抗网络（GAN）的扩展行为：在紧凑的变分自编码器（VAE）潜空间中训练，以及使用纯 Transformer 架构的生成器与判别器。

sentences.en: While this setup is efficient and scales well with compute, naively scaling exposes failure modes; underutilization of early layers in the generator and increasing optimization instability.
sentences.zh: 尽管这种设置高效且能随着算力良好扩展，但朴素地放大规模会暴露一些失败模式：生成器早期层利用不足，以及优化不稳定性加剧。

sentences.en: We address these issues with lightweight intermediate supervision and width-aware learning-rate adjustment.
sentences.zh: 我们通过轻量级中间监督和宽度感知的学习率调整来解决这些问题。

sentences.en: Our Generative Adversarial Transformers (GAT) train reliably from small (S) to extra-large (XL) model sizes, and GAT-XL model achieves state-of-the-art single-step class-conditional generation on ImageNet at 256×256 resolution (FID of 2.18) in 60 epochs, requiring 4x fewer epochs than strong baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们的生成对抗 Transformer（GAT）能从小型（S）到超大型（XL）模型规模可靠地训练，其中 GAT-XL 模型在 ImageNet 上以 256×256 分辨率（FID 为 2.18）仅用 60 个 epoch 就实现了最先进的单步类别条件生成，所需的 epoch 数比强基线少 4 倍。

title_en: Scalable Kronecker-Factored Fisher Approximation for Neural Network Parameter Sensitivity
title_zh: 用于神经网络参数敏感性的可扩展 Kronecker 因式分解 Fisher 近似

sentences.en: The Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) provides a principled geometric framework for parameter sensitivity in neural networks, but directly computing and using the full FIM is infeasible in high-dimensional models.
sentences.zh: Fisher 信息矩阵（FIM）为神经网络中的参数敏感性提供了原则性的几何框架，但在高维模型中直接计算和使用完整的 FIM 是不可行的。

sentences.en: As a result, most existing methods rely on diagonal approximations that discard important correlation structure.
sentences.zh: 因此，现有的大多数方法都依赖会丢弃重要相关结构的对角近似。

sentences.en: We introduce Matrix-free Fisher Factorization (MFF), a GPU-tractable algorithm that captures both diagonal and off-diagonal dependencies without materializing the full matrix.
sentences.zh: 我们提出无矩阵 Fisher 分解（Matrix-free Fisher Factorization，MFF），这是一种可在 GPU 上处理的算法，无需实例化完整矩阵即可捕获对角与非对角依赖。

sentences.en: For post-training neural network layer compression, we prove that under Matrix-Variate Normal assumptions, MFF yields GFWSVD, a unique closed-form linear layer decomposition that optimally minimizes the expected second-order loss increase.
sentences.zh: 对于训练后的神经网络层压缩，我们证明在矩阵变量正态（Matrix-Variate Normal）假设下，MFF 可导出 GFWSVD，一种独特的闭式线性层分解，能以最优方式最小化预期的二阶损失增加。

sentences.en: Experiments on controlled numerical benchmarks with large neural networks show that GFWSVD achieves up to 50\% compression while matching or exceeding state-of-the-art diagonal and activation-based baselines across most tasks, and it reliably avoids collapse in dense architectures such as Llama 3.
sentences.zh: 在包含大型神经网络的受控数值基准上的实验表明，在大多数任务上，GFWSVD 在达到至多 50\% 压缩率的同时，能达到或超过最先进的对角与基于激活的基线，并且能在 Llama 3 等稠密架构中可靠地避免崩溃。

sentences.en: Moreover, when used to initialize existing optimization pipelines (e.g., Dobi-SVD), GFWSVD better preserves accuracy at 40\% parameter reduction in regimes where standard methods substantially degrade.
sentences.zh: 此外，当用于初始化现有优化流程（如 Dobi-SVD）时，在标准方法显著退化的场景下，GFWSVD 在 40\% 参数缩减时能更好地保持精度。

sentences.en: Together, these results position MFF and GFWSVD as foundational algorithmic primitives for scalable, second-order-aware neural network approximation and parameter sensitivity.
sentences.zh: 综上，这些结果使 MFF 与 GFWSVD 成为用于可扩展、二阶感知的神经网络逼近与参数敏感性的基础算法原语。

title_en: Scalable Medical Multimodal Fusion via Symmetric Consistency Modeling
title_zh: 基于对称一致性建模的可扩展医疗多模态融合

sentences.en: Medical diagnosis tasks often rely on heterogeneous information from multiple sources, such as medical images and clinical text.
sentences.zh: 医疗诊断任务通常依赖来自多个来源的异构信息，例如医学影像与临床文本。

sentences.en: Multimodal fusion is therefore essential for improving classification performance and robustness.
sentences.zh: 因此，多模态融合对于提升分类性能与鲁棒性至关重要。

sentences.en: However, most existing methods assume a fixed and known modality set, making them less effective when the number or composition of modalities changes.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的大多数方法都假设模态集合是固定且已知的，当模态的数量或构成发生变化时，这些方法的效果会大打折扣。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose a modality-agnostic medical multimodal fusion framework that can naturally accommodate an arbitrary number of input modalities.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一局限，我们提出一种与模态无关的医疗多模态融合框架，能够自然地容纳任意数量的输入模态。

sentences.en: At the coarse-grained modality level, we represent each modality’s estimation of latent semantics as an uncertainty-aware probability distribution, and impose symmetric consistency constraints to achieve global cross-modal semantic alignment.
sentences.zh: 在粗粒度的模态层面，我们将每个模态对潜在语义的估计表示为不确定性感知的概率分布，并施加对称一致性约束，以实现全局的跨模态语义对齐。

sentences.en: At the fine-grained token level, we further design a token-level consistency constraint based on linear reconstruction.
sentences.zh: 在细粒度的 token 层面，我们进一步设计了基于线性重构的 token 级一致性约束。

sentences.en: This constraint enables structured mutual verification of local semantics across modalities.
sentences.zh: 该约束实现了跨模态局部语义的结构化相互验证。

sentences.en: Finally, for multimodal fusion, we adopt a multi-view consistency strategy to obtain a unified representation for diagnosis prediction.
sentences.zh: 最后，对于多模态融合，我们采用多视角一致性策略来获得用于诊断预测的统一表示。

sentences.en: In particular, each modality is sequentially treated as a conditional view to suppress noise in the remaining modalities and extract shared semantics.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，每个模态依次被当作条件视图，以抑制其余模态中的噪声并提取共享语义。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on five public and self-constructed multimodal medical datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed approach.
sentences.zh: 在五个公开及自构建的多模态医疗数据集上的大量实验，证明了所提方法的有效性与可扩展性。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/gjhgjbkg/SMMF.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/gjhgjbkg/SMMF 获取。

title_en: Scalable Option Learning in High-Throughput Environments
title_zh: 高通量环境中的可扩展选项学习

sentences.en: Hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL) has the potential to enable effective decision-making over long timescales.
sentences.zh: 分层强化学习（RL）有潜力在长期时间尺度上实现有效的决策。

sentences.en: Existing approaches, while promising, have yet to realize the benefits of large-scale training.
sentences.zh: 现有方法虽然前景可期，但尚未实现大规模训练的收益。

sentences.en: In this work, we identify and solve several key challenges in scaling online hierarchical RL to high-throughput environments.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们识别并解决了将在线分层 RL 扩展到高通量环境所面临的几个关键挑战。

sentences.en: We propose Scalable Option Learning (SOL), a highly scalable hierarchical policy gradient algorithm which achieves a ~35x higher throughput compared to existing hierarchical methods.
sentences.zh: 我们提出可扩展选项学习（Scalable Option Learning，SOL），一种高度可扩展的分层策略梯度算法，与现有分层方法相比可实现约 35x 的更高吞吐量。

sentences.en: To demonstrate SOL's performance and scalability, we train hierarchical agents using 30 billion frames of experience on the complex game of NetHack, significantly surpassing flat agents and demonstrating positive scaling trends.
sentences.zh: 为展示 SOL 的性能与可扩展性，我们在复杂游戏 NetHack 上使用 300 亿帧经验训练分层智能体，显著超越了扁平智能体，并展现出积极的扩展趋势。

sentences.en: We also validate SOL on MiniHack and Mujoco environments, showcasing its general applicability.
sentences.zh: 我们还在 MiniHack 和 Mujoco 环境中验证了 SOL，展示了其广泛的适用性。

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Scalable Power Sampling: Unlocking Efficient, Training-Free Reasoning for LLMs via Distribution Sharpening
title_zh: 可扩展幂采样：通过分布锐化释放面向 LLM 的高效免训练推理

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training is a dominant approach for improving the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), yet growing evidence suggests that its gains arise primarily from distribution sharpening rather than the acquisition of new capabilities.
sentences.zh: 强化学习（RL）后训练是提升大型语言模型（LLM）推理性能的主流方法，然而越来越多的证据表明，其收益主要源于分布锐化（distribution sharpening），而非新能力的习得。

sentences.en: Recent work has shown that sampling from the power distribution of LLMs using Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) can recover performance comparable to RL post-training without relying on external rewards; however, the high computational cost of MCMC makes such approaches impractical for widespread adoption.
sentences.zh: 近期研究表明，使用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）从 LLM 的幂分布中采样，可以在不依赖外部奖励的情况下恢复与 RL 后训练相当的推理性能；然而，MCMC 的高计算成本使这类方法难以被广泛采用。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a theoretically grounded alternative that eliminates the need for iterative MCMC.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出一种有理论依据的替代方法，消除了对迭代 MCMC 的需求。

sentences.en: We derive a novel formulation showing that the global power distribution can be approximated by a token-level scaled low-temperature one, where the scaling factor captures future trajectory quality.
sentences.zh: 我们推导出一种新的公式，表明全局幂分布可以由 token 级的缩放低温分布来近似，其中缩放因子刻画了未来轨迹质量。

sentences.en: Leveraging this insight, we introduce a training-free and verifier-free algorithm that sharpens the base model's generative distribution autoregressively.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出一种免训练且免验证器的算法，以自回归方式锐化基础模型的生成分布。

sentences.en: Empirically, we evaluate our method on math, QA, and code tasks, and show that our method matches or surpasses one-shot GRPO without relying on any external rewards, while reducing inference latency by over $10\times$ compared to MCMC-based sampling.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，我们在数学、问答（QA）和代码任务上评估了我们的方法，并表明在无需依赖任何外部奖励的情况下，我们的方法能达到或超过单次 GRPO，同时相比基于 MCMC 的采样将推理延迟降低了超过 $10\times$。

title_en: Scalable Reinforcement Learning via Adaptive Batch Scaling
title_zh: 通过自适应批扩展实现可扩展强化学习

sentences.en: Conventional wisdom holds that large-batch training is fundamentally incompatible with Reinforcement Learning (RL) — beyond a modest threshold, increasing batch sizes typically yields diminishing returns or performance degradation due to the inherent non-stationarity of the data distribution.
sentences.zh: 传统观点认为，大批量训练与强化学习（RL）本质上不可兼容——超过一个适度的阈值后，由于数据分布固有的非平稳性，增大批大小通常只会带来边际收益递减或性能下降。

sentences.en: We challenge this view by observing that non-stationarity is not a fixed property of RL, but evolves throughout training: early stages exhibit rapid behavioral shifts that demand small batches for plasticity, whereas late stages approach a quasi-stationary regime where large batches enable precise convergence.
sentences.zh: 我们通过观察到非平稳性并非 RL 的固定属性、而是随训练过程演化来挑战这一观点：早期阶段表现出快速的行为变化，需要小批量以保持可塑性；而后期阶段接近准平稳状态，此时大批量可实现精确收敛。

sentences.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose Adaptive Batch Scaling (ABS), that dynamically adjusts the effective batch size according to the stability of the learning policy.
sentences.zh: 受这一观察启发，我们提出自适应批扩展（Adaptive Batch Scaling，ABS），它根据学习策略的稳定性动态调整有效批大小。

sentences.en: Central to ABS is Behavioral Divergence, a novel metric that quantifies policy non-stationarity by measuring action-level shifts between consecutive updates, which we use to scale batch size inversely to policy volatility.
sentences.zh: ABS 的核心是行为散度（Behavioral Divergence），一种新颖的指标，通过衡量相邻更新之间的动作级变化来量化策略非平稳性，我们利用它按策略波动性的反比来缩放批大小。

sentences.en: Integrated with the Parallelised Q-Network (PQN) algorithm and evaluated on the ALE benchmark, ABS seamlessly reconciles early-stage plasticity with late-stage stable convergence.
sentences.zh: 与并行 Q 网络（PQN）算法集成并在 ALE 基准上评估后，ABS 无缝地协调了早期阶段的可塑性与后期阶段的稳定收敛。

sentences.en: Strikingly, contrary to conventional wisdom, our results reveal that the combination of larger networks and larger batch sizes achieves the best performance — a scaling behavior previously thought to be unattainable in RL, now unlocked through adaptive batch control.
sentences.zh: 引人注目的是，与传统的认知相反，我们的结果表明，更大的网络与更大的批大小相结合能取得最佳性能——这是一种此前被认为在 RL 中无法实现的扩展行为，如今通过自适应批控制得以解锁。

title_en: Scalable RF Simulation in Generative 4D Worlds
title_zh: 生成式 4D 世界中的可扩展射频仿真

sentences.en: Radio Frequency (RF) sensing has emerged as a powerful, privacy-preserving alternative to vision-based methods for various perception tasks.
sentences.zh: 射频（RF）感知已成为面向多种感知任务的、强大且保护隐私的视觉方法替代方案。

sentences.en: However, building high-quality RF datasets in dynamic and diverse environments remains a major challenge.
sentences.zh: 然而，在动态且多样化的环境中构建高质量的 RF 数据集仍然是一项重大挑战。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce WaveVerse, a prompt-based, scalable framework that simulates realistic RF signals from generated indoor scenes with human motions guided by spatial paths, enabling diverse and feasible behaviors without manual trajectory design.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出 WaveVerse，一个基于提示词的可扩展框架，能够从生成的室内场景中模拟真实的 RF 信号，场景中的人体运动由空间路径引导，从而无需手动设计轨迹即可实现多样且可行的行为。

sentences.en: WaveVerse features a language-guided 4D world generator and a physics-based signal simulator that enables realistic simulation of RF signals in diverse environments.
sentences.zh: WaveVerse 具有一个语言引导的 4D 世界生成器和一个基于物理的信号模拟器，能够在多样化的环境中实现 RF 信号的真实仿真。

sentences.en: It employs a phase-coherent ray tracer that preserves both spatial and temporal phase consistency.
sentences.zh: 它采用相位相干的射线追踪器，同时保持空间与时间上的相位一致性。

sentences.en: The simulated signals show high fidelity on phase-sensitive benchmarks, and closely align with both real-world collected measurements and simulations from a proprietary electromagnetic solver.
sentences.zh: 仿真信号在相位敏感的基准上表现出高保真度，并与真实采集的测量数据以及专有电磁求解器的仿真结果高度一致。

sentences.en: When used for data augmentation, WaveVerse consistently improves performance in downstream tasks like RF imaging and human activity recognition, with gains that grow with the amount of simulated data and surpass existing methods.
sentences.zh: 当用于数据增强时，WaveVerse 能持续提升射频成像、人体活动识别等下游任务的性能，其增益随仿真数据量的增加而增长，并超越现有方法。

sentences.en: Code and additional materials are available on the webpage.
sentences.zh: 代码与更多材料可在网页上获取。

title_en: Scalable Simulation-Based Model Inference with Test-Time Complexity Control
title_zh: 具有测试时复杂度控制的可扩展基于仿真的模型推断

sentences.en: Simulation plays a central role in scientific discovery.
sentences.zh: 仿真在科学发现中发挥着核心作用。

sentences.en: In many applications, the bottleneck is no longer running a simulator—it is choosing among large families of plausible simulators, each corresponding to different forward models/hypotheses consistent with observations.
sentences.zh: 在许多应用中，瓶颈不再是运行仿真器，而是在庞大的合理仿真器族中作出选择——每个仿真器对应与观测一致的不同前向模型/假设。

sentences.en: Over large model families, classical Bayesian workflows for model-selection are impractical.
sentences.zh: 面对庞大的模型族，用于模型选择的经典贝叶斯工作流不切实际。

sentences.en: Furthermore, amortized model-selection methods typically hard-code a fixed model prior—or complexity penalty—at training time, requiring users to commit to a particular parsimony assumption before seeing the data.
sentences.zh: 此外，摊销式（amortized）模型选择方法通常在训练时硬编码固定的模型先验——或复杂度惩罚——这要求用户在查看数据之前就承诺某种特定的简约性假设。

sentences.en: We introduce PRISM, a simulation-based encoder-decoder that infers a joint posterior over both discrete model structures and associated continuous parameters, while enabling test-time control of model complexity via a tunable model prior that the network is conditioned on.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 PRISM，一种基于仿真的编码器-解码器，它能推断离散模型结构与相关连续参数上的联合后验，同时通过网络所依赖的可调模型先验，实现在测试时控制模型复杂度。

sentences.en: We show that PRISM scales to families with combinatorially many (up to billions of) model instantiations on a synthetic symbolic regression task.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，在合成符号回归任务上，PRISM 可扩展到具有组合级数量（多达数十亿）模型实例的模型族。

sentences.en: As a scientific application, we evaluate PRISM on biophysical modeling for diffusion MRI data, showing the ability to perform model selection across several multi-compartment models, on both synthetic and in-vivo neuroimaging data.
sentences.zh: 作为一项科学应用，我们在扩散 MRI 数据的生物物理建模上评估了 PRISM，展示了其在合成与在体（in-vivo）神经影像数据上跨多个多隔室模型进行模型选择的能力。

title_en: Scalable Single-Cell Gene Expression Generation with Latent Diffusion Models
title_zh: 基于潜扩散模型的可扩展单细胞基因表达生成

sentences.en: Computational modeling of single-cell gene expression is crucial for understanding cellular processes, but generating realistic expression profiles remains a major challenge.
sentences.zh: 单细胞基因表达的计算建模对理解细胞过程至关重要，但生成真实的表达谱仍是一项重大挑战。

sentences.en: This difficulty arises from the count nature of gene expression data and complex latent dependencies among genes.
sentences.zh: 这一困难源于基因表达数据的计数（count）特性以及基因之间复杂的潜在依赖关系。

sentences.en: Existing generative models often impose artificial gene orderings or rely on shallow neural network architectures.
sentences.zh: 现有生成模型往往强加人为的基因顺序，或依赖于较浅的神经网络架构。

sentences.en: We introduce a scalable latent diffusion model for single-cell gene expression data, which we refer to as scLDM, that respects the fundamental exchangeability property of the data.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个用于单细胞基因表达数据的可扩展潜扩散模型，称为 scLDM，它尊重数据的基本可交换性（exchangeability）性质。

sentences.en: Our VAE uses fixed-size latent variables leveraging a unified Multi-head Cross-Attention Block (MCAB) architecture, which serves dual roles: permutation-invariant pooling in the encoder and permutation-equivariant unpooling in the decoder.
sentences.zh: 我们的 VAE 使用固定大小的潜变量，并利用统一的多头交叉注意力模块（MCAB）架构，该模块具有双重作用：在编码器中实现置换不变池化，在解码器中实现置换等变反池化。

sentences.en: We enhance this framework by replacing the Gaussian prior with a latent diffusion model using Diffusion Transformers and linear interpolants, enabling high-quality generation with multi-conditional classifier-free guidance.
sentences.zh: 我们通过用潜扩散模型替换高斯先验来增强这一框架，该潜扩散模型使用 Diffusion Transformer 与线性插值，从而支持多条件分类器自由引导的高质量生成。

sentences.en: We show its superior performance in a variety of experiments for both observational and perturbational single-cell data, as well as downstream tasks like cell-level classification.
sentences.zh: 我们在观测型与扰动型单细胞数据以及细胞级分类等下游任务的大量实验中，展示了其优越的性能。

title_en: Scalable Topology-Preserving Graph Coarsening: Concepts and Algorithms
title_zh: 可扩展的拓扑保持图粗化：概念与算法

sentences.en: Graph coarsening reduces the size of a graph while preserving certain properties.
sentences.zh: 图粗化（graph coarsening）在保留特定性质的同时减小图的大小。

sentences.en: Most existing methods preserve either spectral or spatial characteristics.
sentences.zh: 现有的大多数方法只保留频谱或空间特性中的一种。

sentences.en: Recent research shows that topology-preserving coarsening methods maintain GNN performance on coarsened graphs but suffer from exponential time complexity.
sentences.zh: 近期的研究表明，保持拓扑的粗化方法能在粗化后的图上维持 GNN 性能，但存在指数级时间复杂度的问题。

sentences.en: To address these problems, we propose Scalable Topology-Preserving Graph Coarsening (STPGC) by introducing the concepts of graph strong collapse and graph edge collapse extended from algebraic topology.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们引入源自代数拓扑的图强坍缩（graph strong collapse）与图边坍缩（graph edge collapse）概念，并提出可扩展的拓扑保持图粗化（STPGC）。

sentences.en: STPGC comprises three new algorithms, GStrongCollapse, GEdgeCollapse, and NeighborhoodConing, based on these two concepts, which eliminate dominated nodes and edges while rigorously preserving topological features.
sentences.zh: STPGC 由三种基于这两个概念的新算法组成：GStrongCollapse、GEdgeCollapse 和 NeighborhoodConing，它们在严格保持拓扑特征的同时消除了被支配的节点与边。

sentences.en: We further prove that STPGC preserves the GNN receptive field and develop approximate algorithms to accelerate GNN training.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步证明了 STPGC 能保持 GNN 的感受野，并开发了近似算法来加速 GNN 训练。

sentences.en: Experiments on node classification with GNNs demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of STPGC.
sentences.zh: 在 GNN 节点分类上的实验证明了 STPGC 的效率与有效性。

title_en: Scalable Traffic Signal Control with Shared Policy Framework
title_zh: 基于共享策略框架的可扩展交通信号控制

sentences.en: Learning-based Traffic Signal Control (TSC) achieves satisfactory performance in small networks, but its effectiveness often deteriorates in larger networks under dynamic traffic patterns and intersection heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: 基于学习的交通信号控制（TSC）在小型网络中能取得令人满意的性能，但在动态交通模式与路口异质性条件下，其在较大网络中的有效性往往会下降。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose SLight, a policy-aware grouped MARL-TSC framework that enables scalability and efficiency balance under dynamic and heterogeneous traffic conditions.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出 SLight，一个策略感知的分组 MARL-TSC 框架，能够在动态且异质的交通条件下实现可扩展性与效率的平衡。

sentences.en: SLight captures policy-influenced traffic patterns with a policy-aware traffic pattern encoder, learns explicit group-level shared control principles from state–action trajectories, and matches each intersection’s traffic pattern embedding to principle prototypes flexibly through a compatibility-based adaptive assignment module.
sentences.zh: SLight 通过策略感知的交通模式编码器捕捉受策略影响的交通模式，从状态-动作轨迹中学习显式的组级共享控制原则，并通过基于兼容性的自适应分配模块，灵活地将每个路口的交通模式嵌入与原则原型进行匹配。

sentences.en: Experiments on real-world and synthetic networks demonstrate that SLight sustains performance gains as scale increases and outperforms existing rule-based, reinforcement learning, and grouping-based baselines.
sentences.zh: 在真实与合成网络上的实验表明，随着规模增大，SLight 能持续保持性能增益，并优于现有的基于规则、强化学习与基于分组的方法。

sentences.en: Code is available at \url{https://github.com/MaHaoLun/Slight-code.git}
sentences.zh: 代码可在 \url{https://github.com/MaHaoLun/Slight-code.git} 获取。

title_en: Scalable Training of 3D Gaussian Splatting via Out-of-Core Optimization
title_zh: 通过核外优化实现 3D 高斯泼溅的可扩展训练

sentences.en: Training 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) at billion-primitive scale is fundamentally memory-bound: each Gaussian carries a large attribute vector, and the aggregate parameter table quickly exceeds GPU capacity, limiting prior systems to tens of millions of Gaussians on consumer hardware.
sentences.zh: 以十亿基元规模训练 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）从根本上受内存限制：每个高斯都携带一个大型属性向量，聚合参数表迅速超出 GPU 容量，导致先前的系统在消费级硬件上只能处理数千万个高斯。

sentences.en: We observe that 3DGS training is inherently sparse and trajectory-conditioned: each iteration activates only the Gaussians visible from the current camera batch, so GPU memory can serve as a working-set cache rather than a persistent parameter store.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，3DGS 训练本质上是稀疏且由轨迹条件化的：每次迭代只激活当前相机批次可见的高斯，因此 GPU 内存可以充当工作集缓存，而非持久的参数存储。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we introduce \textbf{TideGS}, an out-of-core training framework that manages parameters across an SSD--CPU--GPU hierarchy via three synergistic techniques: block-virtualized geometry for SSD-aligned spatial locality, a hierarchical asynchronous pipeline to overlap I/O with computation, and trajectory-adaptive differential streaming that transfers only incremental working-set deltas between iterations.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出 \textbf{TideGS}，一个核外训练框架，通过三种协同技术管理跨 SSD--CPU--GPU 层级分布的参数：用于 SSD 对齐空间局部性的块虚拟化几何、将 I/O 与计算重叠的分层异步流水线，以及只在迭代之间传输增量工作集变化量的轨迹自适应差分流。

sentences.en: Experiments show that TideGS enables training with \textbf{over one billion Gaussians} on a single consumer GPU while achieving state-of-the-art reconstruction quality on large-scale scenes, exceeding prior out-of-core baselines (e.g., $\sim$100M Gaussians) and standard in-memory training (e.g., $\sim$11M Gaussians).
sentences.zh: 实验表明，TideGS 能够在单个消费级 GPU 上训练 \textbf{超过十亿个高斯}，同时在大规模场景上取得最先进的重建质量，超越了先前的核外基线（例如 $\sim$100M 个高斯）和标准内存内训练（例如 $\sim$11M 个高斯）。

title_en: SCalDA: Semantics-Calibrated and Diffusion-Enhanced Data Augmentation
title_zh: SCalDA：语义校准与扩散增强的数据增广

sentences.en: With the rapid development of deep learning, the issue of data scarcity has become increasingly prominent, inspiring emerging interests towards research on data augmentation techniques over recent years.
sentences.zh: 随着深度学习的快速发展，数据稀缺问题日益突出，近年来激发了人们对数据增广技术研究的新兴趣。

sentences.en: However, our literature survey indicates that existing efforts often suffer from two issues of semantic infidelity, including: (i) visual semantics infidelity, such as visual artifacts, manifold intrusion, and unnatural blending boundaries etc, and (ii) label semantic infidelity, where augmented images do not match the original labels, creating extra label noises.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们的文献调研表明，现有工作常常存在两类语义失真（semantic infidelity）问题，包括：（i）视觉语义失真，如视觉伪影、流形侵入、不自然的融合边界等；（ii）标签语义失真，即增广图像与原始标签不匹配，产生额外的标签噪声。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose a Semantics Calibrated and Diffusion-Enhanced Augmentation (SCalDA) scheme to achieve accurate semantics calibration across image, label and feature domains.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出一种语义校准与扩散增强增广（SCalDA）方案，以在图像、标签与特征域实现精确的语义校准。

sentences.en: Compared with the existing approaches, our proposed features in precise guidance in label domain, semantics driven synthesis across three domains (image, label and feature), and semantics-aware metric learning.
sentences.zh: 与现有方法相比，我们的方法具有如下特点：在标签域提供精确引导、在三个域（图像、标签和特征）中进行语义驱动的合成，以及语义感知的度量学习。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that SCalDA yields consistent and significant performance improvements for both fine-grained and general classification tasks, validating the effectiveness and broad applicability of the proposed.
sentences.zh: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，SCalDA 在细粒度与通用分类任务上均能带来一致且显著的性能提升，验证了所提方法的有效性与广泛适用性。

title_en: Scale-Aware Domain Harmonization for Domain Adaptation Person Search
title_zh: 用于域自适应行人搜索的尺度感知域协调

sentences.en: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) person search aims to transfer a model trained on a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain without using target annotations.
sentences.zh: 无监督域自适应（UDA）行人搜索旨在将在一个有标注的源域上训练的模型迁移到无标注的目标域，而不使用目标域的标注。

sentences.en: However, existing UDA methods frequently neglect the issue of scale inconsistency between the source and target domains.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有 UDA 方法常常忽视源域与目标域之间尺度不一致的问题。

sentences.en: This inconsistency arises from variations in camera height, tilt angle, focal length, and scene layout.
sentences.zh: 这种不一致源于相机高度、倾斜角、焦距和场景布局的变化。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose a Scale-Aware Consistent Alignment Learning (SCALE) framework.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出尺度感知的一致对齐学习（SCALE）框架。

sentences.en: Specifically,  we propose a Scale-aware Domain Harmonization (SDH) module, which adaptively harmonizes semantic and structural scales through cross-path interaction and consistency refinement to alleviate cross-domain scale inconsistency.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们提出一个尺度感知域协调（SDH）模块，它通过跨路径交互与一致性精炼自适应地协调语义尺度和结构尺度，以缓解跨域的尺度不一致。

sentences.en: To further reduce pseudo-label noise, we introduce a Bidirectional Cluster Regularization (BCR) strategy, which improves pseudo-label reliability by refining the clustering results through a second regularized clustering step.
sentences.zh: 为进一步减少伪标签噪声，我们引入双向聚类正则化（BCR）策略，通过第二轮正则化聚类对聚类结果进行精炼，从而提高伪标签的可靠性。

sentences.en: By collaboratively alleviating the impact of scale misalignment and enhancing pseudo-label reliability, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on two benchmark person search datasets, with 82.3% mAP and 84.0% top-1 on the CUHK-SYSU dataset, 41.7% mAP and 82.4% top-1 on the PRW dataset.
sentences.zh: 通过协同缓解尺度失准的影响并增强伪标签的可靠性，我们的方法在两个基准行人搜索数据集上取得了最先进的性能：在 CUHK-SYSU 数据集上 mAP 为 82.3%、top-1 为 84.0%；在 PRW 数据集上 mAP 为 41.7%、top-1 为 82.4%。

sentences.en: Our source code is available at https://github.com/whhbdmu/SCALE.
sentences.zh: 我们的源代码可在 https://github.com/whhbdmu/SCALE 获取。

title_en: SCALE: Self-uncertainty Conditioned Adaptive Looking and Execution for Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: SCALE：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的自不确定性条件化自适应观察与执行

sentences.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robotic control, with test-time scaling (TTS) gaining attention to enhance robustness beyond training.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型已成为通用机器人控制的一种有前景的范式，其中测试时扩展（test-time scaling, TTS）因能增强训练之外的鲁棒性而日益受到关注。

sentences.en: However, existing TTS methods for VLAs require additional training, verifiers, and multiple forward passes, making them impractical for deployment.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的针对 VLA 的 TTS 方法需要额外的训练、验证器和多次前向传播，使其在实际部署中不切实际。

sentences.en: Moreover, they intervene only at action decoding while keeping visual representations fixed—insufficient under perceptual ambiguity, where reconsidering how to perceive is as important as deciding what to do.
sentences.zh: 此外，它们仅在动作解码阶段进行干预，同时保持视觉表示固定不变——这在感知模糊的情形下是不充分的，因为在这种情形下，重新考虑“如何感知”与决定“做什么”同样重要。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose SCALE, a simple inference strategy that jointly modulates visual perception and action based on 'self-uncertainty', inspired by uncertainty-driven exploration in Active Inference theory—requiring no additional training, no verifier, and only a single forward pass.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些局限，我们提出了 SCALE，一种简单的推理策略，它受主动推断（Active Inference）理论中不确定性驱动的探索启发，基于“自不确定定性”联合调节视觉感知与动作——无需额外训练、无需验证器，且仅需单次前向传播。

sentences.en: SCALE broadens exploration in both perception and action under high uncertainty, while focusing on exploitation when confident—enabling adaptive execution across varying conditions.
sentences.zh: SCALE 在高不确定性下拓宽了感知与动作两方面的探索，同时在信心较高时聚焦于利用——从而实现在不同条件下的自适应执行。

sentences.en: Experiments on simulated and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that \method improves state-of-the-art VLAs and outperforms existing TTS methods while maintaining single-pass efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在仿真和真实世界基准上的实验表明，\method 改进了最先进的 VLA 模型，并在保持单次前向传播效率的同时优于现有的 TTS 方法。

title_en: ScaleEnv: Scaling Environment Synthesis from Scratch for Generalist Interactive Tool-Use Agent Training
title_zh: ScaleEnv：从零扩展环境合成，用于通用交互式工具使用智能体训练

sentences.en: Training generalist agents capable of adapting to diverse scenarios requires interactive environments for self-exploration.
sentences.zh: 训练能够适应多样化场景的通用智能体，需要交互式环境来支持自主探索。

sentences.en: However, interactive environments remain critically scarce, and existing synthesis methods suffer from significant limitations regarding environmental diversity and scalability.
sentences.zh: 然而，交互式环境仍然极度稀缺，现有合成方法在环境多样性与可扩展性方面存在显著局限。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we introduce ScaleEnv, a framework that constructs fully interactive environments and verifiable tasks entirely from scratch.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 ScaleEnv，一个完全从零构建交互式环境与可验证任务的框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, ScaleEnv ensures environment reliability through procedural testing, and guarantees task completeness and solvability via tool dependency graph expansion and executable action verification.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，ScaleEnv 通过程序化测试确保环境可靠性，并通过工具依赖图扩展与可执行动作验证来保证任务的完整性与可解性。

sentences.en: By enabling agents to learn through exploration within ScaleEnv, we demonstrate significant performance improvements on unseen, multi-turn tool-use benchmarks such as $\tau^2$-Bench and VitaBench, highlighting strong generalization capabilities.
sentences.zh: 通过让智能体在 ScaleEnv 内进行探索式学习，我们在未见过的多轮工具使用基准（如 $\tau^2$-Bench 与 VitaBench）上展示了显著的性能提升，凸显了强大的泛化能力。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we investigate the relationship between increasing number of domains and model generalization performance, providing empirical evidence that scaling environmental diversity is critical for robust agent learning.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们研究了领域数量增加与模型泛化性能之间的关系，提供了经验证据表明扩展环境多样性对于稳健的智能体学习至关重要。

title_en: ScaleErasure: Inference-Time Minimal Intervention for Precise Concept Erasure in Next-Scale Autoregressive Image Generation
title_zh: ScaleErasure：面向下一代尺度自回归图像生成的推理时最小干预精确概念擦除

sentences.en: Concept erasure aims to prevent image generative models from producing unsafe content while preserving their general generative capability.
sentences.zh: 概念擦除旨在防止图像生成模型产生不安全内容，同时保持其通用生成能力。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, next-scale autoregressive (AR) image generation has recently emerged as a new generative paradigm characterized by next-scale prediction, for which concept erasure remains largely unexplored.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，下一代尺度自回归（AR）图像生成最近作为一种以下一代尺度预测为特征的新生成范式出现，而对这一新范式的概念擦除在很大程度上仍未得到探索。

sentences.en: In this paradigm, semantic information is highly compressed at early scales, leading to severe entanglement between unsafe and unrelated semantics.
sentences.zh: 在该范式中，语义信息在早期尺度上高度压缩，导致不安全语义与无关语义之间出现严重纠缠。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose ScaleErasure, an inference-time concept erasure method that performs minimal intervention.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 ScaleErasure，一种执行最小干预的推理时概念擦除方法。

sentences.en: ScaleErasure precisely selects and guides predicted logits that are most relevant to the unsafe concept, thereby enabling effective erasure under severe semantic entanglement.
sentences.zh: ScaleErasure 精确选择并引导与不安全概念最相关的预测 logits，从而在严重的语义纠缠下实现有效的擦除。

sentences.en: Specifically, ScaleErasure performs two additional forward passes conditioned on the unsafe concept and the corresponding safe concept, and leverages their outputs to guide the target logits away from unsafe concepts toward safe concepts.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，ScaleErasure 基于不安全概念与相应安全概念执行两次额外的前向传播，并利用其输出来引导目标 logits 远离不安全概念、趋向安全概念。

sentences.en: To enable precise and minimal intervention, logits selection and guidance are conducted across three dimensions: scales, tokens, and bit channels.
sentences.zh: 为实现精确且最小化的干预，logits 的选择与引导在三个维度上进行：尺度、token 与比特通道。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that ScaleErasure outperforms adapted baselines in the next-scale AR paradigm, achieving more precise concept erasure while largely preserving general generative capability.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，在下一代尺度 AR 范式中，ScaleErasure 优于适配后的基线方法，在实现更精确概念擦除的同时，大体上保持了通用生成能力。

title_en: ScaleMoE: Mixture-of-Experts for Scalable Continuous Control in Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: ScaleMoE：演员-评论家强化学习中面向可扩展连续控制的专家混合模型

sentences.en: Scaling network remains a bottleneck in deep reinforcement learning (RL): simply enlarging actor–critic networks destabilizes training and soon saturates performance.
sentences.zh: 扩展网络规模仍是深度强化学习（RL）中的一个瓶颈：简单地扩大演员-评论家网络会破坏训练稳定性，并很快使性能达到饱和。

sentences.en: Although recent monolithic architectures such as SimBa and BRC have shown that carefully designed inductive biases can enable positive scaling up to a certain size, their improvements plateau soon as model parameters grow further.
sentences.zh: 尽管诸如 SimBa 和 BRC 等近来出现的单体架构表明，精心设计的归纳偏置能够实现一定规模内的正向扩展，但随着模型参数的进一步增长，它们的改进很快就趋于平稳。

sentences.en: This work introduces ScaleMoE, a scalable RL architecture that integrates Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) modules into both the actor and critic of modern continuous control algorithms.
sentences.zh: 本工作提出了 ScaleMoE，一种可扩展的 RL 架构，它将专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）模块整合进现代连续控制算法的演员与评论家之中。

sentences.en: Two complementary gating schemes are studied: output-level aggregation of per-expert policies and Q-functions, and feature-level fusion of expert representations before a shared head.
sentences.zh: 我们研究了两种互补的门控方案：对各专家策略与 Q 函数的输出级聚合，以及在共享头之前对专家表征的特征级融合。

sentences.en: We instantiate ScaleMoE on two representative monolithic RL baselines: the single-task method SimBa and the multi-task method BRC.
sentences.zh: 我们在两个具有代表性的单体 RL 基线上实例化了 ScaleMoE：单任务方法 SimBa 与多任务方法 BRC。

sentences.en: Experiments across the DeepMind Control Suite, MetaWorld, and HumanoidBench show that progressively increasing the number of experts (up to 64) yields substantial improvements in returns, significantly outperforming monolithic networks of comparable or even greater parameter counts.
sentences.zh: 在 DeepMind Control Suite、MetaWorld 与 HumanoidBench 上的实验表明，逐步增加专家数量（最多 64 个）可带来回报的显著提升，明显优于参数规模相当甚至更大的单体网络。

sentences.en: Results demonstrate that ScaleMoE provides an   efficient and effective scaling axis for deep RL in continuous control.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，ScaleMoE 为连续控制中的深度 RL 提供了一条高效而有效的扩展轴。

title_en: ScaleSim: Serving Large-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation with Invocation Distance-Based Memory Management
title_zh: ScaleSim：基于调用距离内存管理的规模化多智能体仿真服务

sentences.en: LLM-based multi-agent simulations are increasingly adopted across application domains, but remain difficult to scale due to GPU memory pressure.
sentences.zh: 基于 LLM 的多智能体仿真正越来越多地应用于各个领域，但由于 GPU 内存压力而仍难以扩展。

sentences.en: Each agent maintains private GPU-resident states, including models, prefix caches, and adapters, which quickly exhaust device memory as the agent count grows.
sentences.zh: 每个智能体都维护着驻留于 GPU 的私有状态，包括模型、前缀缓存与适配器，随着智能体数量增长，这些状态会迅速耗尽设备内存。

sentences.en: We identify two key properties of these workloads: sparse agent activation and an estimable agent invocation order.
sentences.zh: 我们识别了这些工作负载的两个关键特性：稀疏的智能体激活与可估计的智能体调用顺序。

sentences.en: Based on an analysis of representative workload classes, we introduce invocation distance, a unified abstraction that estimates the relative order in which agents will issue future LLM requests.
sentences.zh: 基于对代表性工作负载类别的分析，我们引入了调用距离（invocation distance），一种估计智能体未来发出 LLM 请求的相对顺序的统一抽象。

sentences.en: Leveraging this abstraction, we present ScaleSim, a memory-efficient LLM serving system for large-scale multi-agent simulations.
sentences.zh: 借力这一抽象，我们提出了 ScaleSim，一种面向大规模多智能体仿真的内存高效 LLM 服务系统。

sentences.en: ScaleSim enables proactive prefetching and priority-based eviction, supports diverse agent-specific memory through a modular interface, and achieves up to 1.74$\times$ speedup over SGLang on simulation benchmarks.
sentences.zh: ScaleSim 支持前瞻性预取与基于优先级的驱逐，通过模块化接口支持多样的智能体专属内存，并在仿真基准上相比 SGLang 实现了高达 1.74$\times$ 的加速。

sentences.en: ScaleSim's source code is available at https://github.com/PanZaifeng/KVFlow.
sentences.zh: ScaleSim 的源代码可在 https://github.com/PanZaifeng/KVFlow 获取。

title_en: Scaling Agentic Verifier for Competitive Coding
title_zh: 面向竞技编程的智能体验证器的规模化扩展

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong coding capabilities but still struggle to solve competitive programming problems correctly in a single attempt.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已展现出强大的编码能力，但仍难以在一次尝试中正确解决竞技编程问题。

sentences.en: Execution-based re-ranking offers a promising test-time scaling strategy, yet existing methods are constrained by either difficult test case generation or inefficient random input sampling.
sentences.zh: 基于执行的重新排序提供了一种有前景的测试时扩展策略，但现有方法要么受限于困难的测试用例生成，要么受限于低效的随机输入采样。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose **Agentic Verifier**, an execution-based agent that actively reasons about program behaviors and searches for highly discriminative test inputs that expose behavioral discrepancies among candidate solutions.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一局限，我们提出了 **Agentic Verifier**（智能体验证器），一个基于执行的智能体，它主动推理程序行为，并搜索具有高度区分性的测试输入，以揭示候选解之间的行为差异。

sentences.en: Through multi-turn interaction with code execution environments, the verifier iteratively refines the candidate input generator and produces targeted counterexamples rather than blindly sampling inputs.
sentences.zh: 通过与代码执行环境的多轮交互，验证器迭代式地改进候选输入生成器，并产出有针对性的反例，而非盲目地采样输入。

sentences.en: We train the verifier to acquire this discriminative input generation capability via a scalable pipeline combining large-scale data synthesis, rejection fine-tuning, and agentic reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 我们通过一个结合大规模数据合成、拒绝微调与智能体强化学习的可扩展流程，训练验证器习得这种区分性输入生成能力。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across five competitive programming benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong execution-based baselines, achieving up to **+10-15\%** absolute gains in Best@$k$ accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在五个竞技编程基准上的大量实验表明，相比基于执行的强基线，它取得了一致的改进，在 Best@$k$ 准确率上实现了高达 **+10-15\%** 的绝对提升。

sentences.en: Further analysis reveals clear test-time scaling behavior and highlights the verifier’s broader potential beyond reranking.
sentences.zh: 进一步的分析揭示了清晰的测试时扩展行为，并凸显了验证器在重新排序之外的更广泛潜力。
