title_en: ScenePilot: Controllable Boundary-Driven Critical Scenario Generation for Autonomous Driving
title_zh: ScenePilot：面向自动驾驶的可控边界驱动关键场景生成

sentences.en: Safety-critical scenarios are central to evaluating autonomous driving systems, yet their rarity in naturalistic logs makes simulation-based stress testing indispensable.
sentences.zh: 安全关键场景对于评估自动驾驶系统至关重要，然而它们在自然日志中的稀缺性使得基于仿真的压力测试不可或缺。

sentences.en: Most scenario generation methods treat surrounding agents as adversaries, but they either (i) induce failures without explicitly modeling vehicle-road physical limits, yielding visually extreme yet physically unsolvable crashes, or (ii) enforce physical feasibility or policy feasibility in isolation, which can over-focus on aggressive maneuvers or remain tied to a controller-dependent capability boundary.
sentences.zh: 大多数场景生成方法将周围智能体视为对抗者，但它们要么(i)在不显式建模车辆-道路物理极限的情况下诱导失败，从而产生视觉上极端但在物理上无法解决的碰撞；要么(ii)孤立地强制物理可行性或策略可行性，这可能会过度聚焦于激进的自驾操作，或仍受制于依赖控制器的能力边界。

sentences.en: We propose ScenePilot, a feasibility-guided, boundary-driven framework that targets the boundary band: scenarios that are physically solvable in principle yet still cause the deployed autonomy stack to fail.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 ScenePilot，一个可行性引导、边界驱动的框架，瞄准边界带：即原则上物理上可解、却仍会使已部署的自动驾驶栈（autonomy stack）失败的场景。

sentences.en: We formulate generation as constrained multi-objective reinforcement learning, combining an RSS-derived physical-feasibility score $\sigma$ with an online-learned AV-risk predictor $\Phi$, and introduce step-level feasibility-aware shielding to keep exploration near the feasibility boundary while avoiding infeasible artifacts.
sentences.zh: 我们将生成问题形式化为带约束的多目标强化学习，将一个源自 RSS 的物理可行性得分 $\sigma$ 与一个在线学习的 AV 风险预测器 $\Phi$ 相结合，并引入步骤级的可行性感知屏蔽，使探索保持在可行性边界附近，同时避免不可行的伪影。

sentences.en: Experiments on SafeBench with multiple planners show that ScenePilot yields substantially higher collision rates (+6.2 percentage points) while preserving physical validity, and that adversarial fine-tuning on these boundary-band scenarios consistently reduces downstream crash rates.
sentences.zh: 在 SafeBench 上与多种规划器的实验表明，ScenePilot 在保持物理有效性的同时带来了显著更高的碰撞率（+6.2 个百分点），并且在这些边界带场景上进行对抗性微调能够持续降低下游的崩溃率。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/QiyuRuan/ScenePilot.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/QiyuRuan/ScenePilot 获取。

title_en: SceneSmith: Agentic Generation of Simulation-Ready Indoor Scenes
title_zh: SceneSmith：面向仿真就绪室内场景的智能体化生成

sentences.en: Simulation has become a key tool for training and evaluating home robots at scale, yet existing environments fail to capture the diversity and physical complexity of real indoor spaces.
sentences.zh: 仿真已成为大规模训练与评估家用机器人的关键工具，然而现有环境未能捕捉真实室内空间的多样性与物理复杂性。

sentences.en: Current scene synthesis methods produce sparsely furnished rooms that lack the dense clutter, articulated furniture, and physical properties essential for robotic manipulation.
sentences.zh: 当前的场景合成方法生成家具稀疏的房间，缺乏机器人操作所必需的密集杂乱、铰接家具与物理属性。

sentences.en: We introduce SceneSmith, a hierarchical agentic framework that generates simulation-ready indoor environments from natural language prompts.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 SceneSmith，一个层次化智能体框架，能够根据自然语言提示生成仿真就绪的室内环境。

sentences.en: SceneSmith constructs scenes through successive stages—from architectural layout to furniture placement to small object population—each implemented as an interaction among VLM agents: designer, critic, and orchestrator.
sentences.zh: SceneSmith 通过连续阶段构建场景——从建筑布局到家具摆放再到小型物体填充——每个阶段都实现为 VLM 智能体（设计师、评论家与编排器）之间的交互。

sentences.en: The framework tightly integrates asset generation through text-to-3D synthesis for static objects, dataset retrieval for articulated objects, and physical property estimation.
sentences.zh: 该框架通过针对静态物体的文本到 3D 合成、针对铰接物体的数据集检索以及物理属性估计，紧密集成了资产生成。

sentences.en: SceneSmith generates 3-6x more objects than prior methods, with $<$2\% inter-object collisions and 96\% of objects remaining stable under physics simulation.
sentences.zh: SceneSmith 生成的物体数量是先前方法的 3-6 倍，物体间碰撞率低于 $<\%，并且 96\% 的物体在物理仿真下保持稳定。

sentences.en: In a user study with 205 participants, it achieves 92\% average realism and 91\% average prompt faithfulness win rates against baselines.
sentences.zh: 在一项有 205 名参与者参与的用户研究中，它相对于基线分别取得了 92\% 的平均真实感与 91\% 的平均提示忠实度胜率。

sentences.en: We further demonstrate that these environments can be used in an end-to-end pipeline for automatic robot policy evaluation.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步证明，这些环境可以用于一个端到端管线，以实现自动化的机器人策略评估。

title_en: Scheduling LLM Inference with Uncertainty-Aware Output Length Predictions
title_zh: 利用不确定性感知的输出长度预测调度 LLM 推理

sentences.en: To schedule LLM inference, the \textit{shortest job first} (SJF) principle is favorable by prioritizing requests with short output lengths to avoid head-of-line (HOL) blocking.
sentences.zh: 为调度 LLM 推理，\textit{最短作业优先}（SJF）原则是有利的，它通过优先处理输出长度较短的请求来避免队头（HOL）阻塞。

sentences.en: Existing methods usually predict a single output length for each request to facilitate scheduling.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通常为每个请求预测单一的输出长度，以方便调度。

sentences.en: We argue that such a \textit{point estimate} does not match the \textit{stochastic} decoding process of LLM inference, where output length is \textit{uncertain} by nature and determined by when the end-of-sequence (EOS) token is sampled.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这种\textit{点估计}与 LLM 推理的\textit{随机}解码过程不匹配，因为输出长度本质上是\textit{不确定的}，由结束序列（EOS）token 被采样的时机决定。

sentences.en: Hence, the output length of each request should be fitted with a distribution rather than a single value.
sentences.zh: 因此，每个请求的输出长度应当用分布而非单一值来拟合。

sentences.en: With an in-depth analysis of empirical data and the stochastic decoding process, we observe that  output length follows a heavy-tailed distribution and can be fitted with the log-t distribution.
sentences.zh: 通过对经验数据与随机解码过程的深入分析，我们观察到输出长度遵循重尾分布，并且可以用 log-t 分布来拟合。

sentences.en: On this basis, we propose a simple metric called Tail Inflated Expectation (TIE) to replace the output length in SJF scheduling, which adjusts the expectation of a log-t distribution with its tail probabilities to account for the risk that a request generates long outputs.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们提出一个名为尾部膨胀期望（Tail Inflated Expectation, TIE）的简单指标来取代 SJF 调度中的输出长度，该指标用其尾部概率调整 log-t 分布的期望，以考虑请求生成长输出所带来的风险。

sentences.en: To evaluate our TIE scheduler, we compare it with three strong baselines, and the results show that TIE reduces the per-token latency by $2.31\times$ for online inference and improves throughput by $1.42\times$ for offline data generation.
sentences.zh: 为评估我们的 TIE 调度器，我们将其与三个强基线进行比较，结果表明 TIE 将在线推理的每 token 延迟降低了 $2.31\times$，并将离线数据生成的吞吐量提升了 $1.42\times$。

title_en: Scheduling Thoughts: Learning the Order of Thought in Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 调度思想：在扩散语言模型中学习思考顺序

sentences.en: Masked diffusion language models decode by iteratively unmasking tokens, where the unmasking order defines an ``order of thought''  that strongly influences generation quality yet is typically chosen heuristically.
sentences.zh: 掩码扩散语言模型通过迭代去掩码 token 进行解码，其中去掩码顺序定义了一种“思考顺序”，它强烈影响生成质量，却通常是启发式选择的。

sentences.en: We derive a tractable upper bound on the sequential decoding mismatch, measured by the Kullback–Leibler divergence and expressed in terms of the model’s pathwise log-likelihood, with tightness under sufficient model expressivity.
sentences.zh: 我们推导出顺序解码失配的一个可处理的上界，用 Kullback–Leibler 散度度量，并以模型的路径概率对数似然表示，且在模型表达力充分时该上界是紧的。

sentences.en: This bound induces a dense self-aware reward for a target sequence $x$ and unmasking order $\sigma$,  over ordered paths, casting order selection as a principled policy optimization problem with a frozen denoiser.
sentences.zh: 该界为一条目标序列 $x$ 与去掩码顺序 $\sigma$ 引入了基于有序路径的稠密自感知奖励，将顺序选择转化为一个在冻结去噪器下的原则性策略优化问题。

sentences.en: We instantiate this idea as **Self-Aware Scheduling (SAS)**, which learns a lightweight order policy using Group Relative Policy Optimization and applies seamlessly to both sequential and semi-autoregressive decoding.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一思想实例化为**自感知调度（Self-Aware Scheduling, SAS）**，它使用组相对策略优化学习一个轻量级顺序策略，并无缝适用于顺序解码与半自回归解码。

sentences.en: On Sudoku with 1B MDM, SAS improves puzzle accuracy from $82.0\%$ (best heuristic schedule) to $91.8\%$, and reaches $97.9\%$ with second-stage fine-tuning along learned trajectories.
sentences.zh: 在 1B MDM 的 Sudoku 上，SAS 将谜题准确率从 $82.0\%$（最佳启发式调度）提升到 $91.8\%$，并通过沿学习到的轨迹进行第二阶段微调达到 $97.9\%$。

sentences.en: On LLaDA-8B, SAS improves pass@1 on GSM8K from $64\%$ to $76\%$ (full diffusion) and on MBPP from $39.5\%$ to $41\%$, while consistently matching or exceeding heuristic schedules across generation lengths and block sizes.
sentences.zh: 在 LLaDA-8B 上，SAS 将 GSM8K 的 pass@1 从 $64\%$ 提升到 $76\%$（完全扩散），将 MBPP 的 pass@1 从 $39.5\%$ 提升到 $41\%$，同时在不同生成长度与块大小上始终匹配或超过启发式调度。

title_en: SCHUR-A*: Layer-wise Optimal Expert Pruning for MoEs via Schur-Complement Guided A* Search
title_zh: SCHUR-A*：通过 Schur 补引导的 A* 搜索对 MoE 进行逐层最优专家剪枝

sentences.en: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models enable conditional computation but face deployment challenges due to the memory wall: while few experts are activated per token, the entire model must reside in memory.
sentences.zh: 稀疏专家混合（MoE）语言模型实现了条件计算，但面临内存墙（memory wall）带来的部署挑战：虽然每个 token 只激活少量专家，整个模型却必须驻留在内存中。

sentences.en: Existing expert pruning methods primarily rely on independent ranking, failing to account for the complex inter-dependencies and redundancies between experts.
sentences.zh: 现有的专家剪枝方法主要依赖独立排序，未能考虑专家之间复杂的相互依赖与冗余。

sentences.en: In this paper, we formulate post-training MoE pruning as a reconstruction-driven subset selection problem, aiming to minimize layer-output distortion under a cardinality constraint.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们将训练后 MoE 剪枝形式化为一个重建驱动的子集选择问题，目标是在基数约束下最小化层输出的失真。

sentences.en: We introduce SCHUR-A*, an algorithm that leverages A* search to achieve globally optimal expert selection within each layer.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 SCHUR-A*，一种利用 A* 搜索在每层内实现全局最优专家选择的算法。

sentences.en: To maintain computational tractability, we derive a novel, admissible heuristic upper bound using a Schur-complement-based relaxation of the reconstruction objective.
sentences.zh: 为保持计算上的可处理性，我们利用重建目标的基于 Schur 补的松弛，推导出一个新颖的、可采纳的启发式上界。

sentences.en: This tight bound allows for aggressive pruning of the search space while mathematically guaranteeing optimality.
sentences.zh: 这个紧致上界允许对搜索空间进行激进剪枝，同时在数学上保证最优性。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we propose an automated strategy to balance fidelity and memory reduction across heterogeneous layers via knee-point detection.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出一种自动化策略，通过拐点（knee-point）检测来平衡异构层之间的保真度与内存削减。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B demonstrate that SCHUR-A* significantly outperforms greedy and ranking-based baselines, maintaining comparable performance even under aggressive pruning ratios.
sentences.zh: 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上的大量实验表明，SCHUR-A* 显著优于贪心与基于排序的基线，即使在激进的剪枝比例下也能保持相当的性能。

title_en: SciAgentGym: Benchmarking Multi-Step Scientific Tool-Use in LLM Agents
title_zh: SciAgentGym：对 LLM 智能体中的多步科学工具使用进行基准测试

sentences.en: Scientific reasoning inherently demands integrating sophisticated toolkits to navigate domain-specific knowledge.
sentences.zh: 科学推理天然要求整合复杂的工具包，以驾驭领域特定的知识。

sentences.en: Yet, current benchmarks largely overlook agents' ability to orchestrate tools for such rigorous workflows.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前的基准在很大程度上忽视了智能体为这种严谨工作流编排工具的能力。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce **SciAgentGym**, a scalable interactive environment featuring 1,780 domain-specific tools across four natural science disciplines, supported by a robust execution infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入了 **SciAgentGym**，一个可扩展的交互式环境，涵盖四个自然科学学科中的 1,780 个领域特定工具，并由一个稳健的执行基础设施提供支持。

sentences.en: Complementing this, we present **SciAgentBench**, a tiered evaluation suite designed to stress-test agentic capabilities from elementary actions to long-horizon workflows.
sentences.zh: 与此相辅相成，我们提出了 **SciAgentBench**，一个分层评估套件，旨在从基础操作到长视界工作流对智能体能力进行压力测试。

sentences.en: Our evaluation identifies a critical bottleneck: state-of-the-art models still struggle with complex scientific tool-use, and their performance degrades substantially as interaction horizons extend.
sentences.zh: 我们的评估识别出一个关键瓶颈：最先进的模型在复杂的科学工具使用上仍然困难重重，并且随着交互视界的延长，它们的性能显著下降。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose **SciForge**, a data synthesis method that models the tool action space as a dependency graph to generate logic-aware training trajectories.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 **SciForge**，一种数据合成方法，将工具动作空间建模为依赖图，以生成逻辑感知的训练轨迹。

sentences.en: By fine-tuning on these trajectories, our SciAgent-8B outperforms the significantly larger Qwen3-VL-235B-Instruct while exhibiting positive cross-domain transfer of scientific tool-use capabilities.
sentences.zh: 通过在这些轨迹上进行微调，我们的 SciAgent-8B 超越了规模大得多的 Qwen3-VL-235B-Instruct，同时展现出科学工具使用能力的正向跨域迁移。

sentences.en: These results underscore the promising potential of next-generation autonomous scientific agents.
sentences.zh: 这些结果凸显了下一代自主科学智能体的巨大潜力。

title_en: Scientific logicality enriched methodology for LLM reasoning: A practice in physics
title_zh: 面向 LLM 推理的科学逻辑性增强方法：物理学中的实践

sentences.en: With the continuous advancement of reasoning abilities in Large Language Models (LLMs), their application to scientific reasoning tasks has gained significant research attention.
sentences.zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）推理能力的持续进步，它们在科学推理任务中的应用已获得显著的研究关注。

sentences.en: Current research primarily emphasizes boosting LLMs' performance on scientific QA benchmarks by training on larger, more comprehensive datasets with extended reasoning chains.
sentences.zh: 当前研究主要通过使用更大、更全面的数据集并配合更长的推理链进行训练，来提升 LLM 在科学问答基准上的表现。

sentences.en: However, these approaches neglect the essence of the scientific reasoning process---logicality, which is the rational foundation to ensure the validity of reasoning steps leading to reliable conclusions.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法忽视了科学推理过程的本质——逻辑性（logicality），它是确保推理步骤有效从而得出可靠结论的理性基础。

sentences.en: In this work, we make the first systematic investigation into the internal logicality underlying LLM scientific reasoning, and develop a scientific logicality-enriched methodology, including a set of assessment criteria and data sampling methods for logicality-guided training, to improve the logical faithfulness as well as task performance.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们首次系统性地研究了 LLM 科学推理背后的内在逻辑性，并开发了一套科学逻辑性增强的方法论，包括一套评估标准与用于逻辑性引导训练的数据采样方法，以提高逻辑忠实度与任务性能。

sentences.en: Further, we take physics, characterized by its diverse logical structures and formalisms, as an exemplar discipline to practise the above methodology.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们以物理学（以其多样的逻辑结构与形式体系著称）作为示范学科，实践上述方法论。

sentences.en: For data construction, we extract scientific problems from academic literature and sample a high-quality dataset exhibiting strong logicality.
sentences.zh: 在数据构建方面，我们从学术文献中提取科学问题，并采样一个展现出强烈逻辑性的高质量数据集。

sentences.en: Experiments based on three different backbone LLMs reveal that: 1) the training data we constructed can effectively improve the scientific logicality in LLM reasoning; and 2) the enriched scientific logicality plays a critical role in solving scientific problems.
sentences.zh: 基于三个不同主干 LLM 的实验表明：1) 我们构建的训练数据能够有效提升 LLM 推理中的科学逻辑性；2) 增强的科学逻辑性在解决科学问题中发挥着关键作用。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/ScienceOne-AI/PhysLogic.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/ScienceOne-AI/PhysLogic 获取。

title_en: SciNet: Evaluating AI Agents in Relation-Aware Scientific Literature Retrieval
title_zh: SciNet：在关系感知的科学文献检索中评估 AI 智能体

sentences.en: AI agents have seen widespread adoption in information retrieval for scientific research, giving rise to tools such as Deep Research.
sentences.zh: AI 智能体在科学研究的信息检索中已得到广泛采用，催生了诸如 Deep Research 之类的工具。

sentences.en: However, existing retrieval agents mainly rely on keyword- or embedding-based methods.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的检索智能体主要依赖基于关键词或基于嵌入的方法。

sentences.en: While effective at capturing content-level similarities, they struggle to understand complex relational networks among scientific papers, such as identifying corroborating or conflicting studies and tracing technological lineages.
sentences.zh: 虽然它们在捕捉内容层面的相似性方面有效，却难以理解科学论文之间复杂的关系网络，例如识别相互印证或相互冲突的研究，以及追溯技术谱系。

sentences.en: This fundamental limitation often results in fragmented knowledge structures, misinterpreted research sentiment, and ineffective modeling of collective scientific progress.
sentences.zh: 这一根本性局限往往导致知识结构碎片化、研究情绪被误读，以及对集体性科学进展进行低效建模。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we introduce **SciNet**, the first **Sci**entific **Net**work relation-aware dataset for information retrieval agents.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局限，我们引入了 **SciNet**，第一个面向信息检索智能体的 **Sci**entific **Net**work（科学网络）关系感知数据集。

sentences.en: Built on a meta-database of 269 million papers across 7 disciplines and containing 8,940 carefully designed tasks, SciNet systematically captures three levels of relational understanding: ego-centric retrieval of papers with novel knowledge structures, pairwise identification of scholarly relationships, and path-wise reconstruction of scientific evolution.
sentences.zh: 它建立在涵盖 7 个学科共 2.69 亿篇论文的元数据库之上，包含 8,940 个精心设计的任务，SciNet 系统地捕捉三个层面的关系理解：检索具有新颖知识结构的论文的自我中心检索、学术关系的成对识别，以及科学演化的路径式重建。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluation of three categories of retrieval agents shows that their accuracy on relation-aware tasks often falls below 20%, highlighting a fundamental shortcoming of current retrieval paradigms.
sentences.zh: 对三类检索智能体的大量评估表明，它们在关系感知任务上的准确率往往低于 20%，凸显了当前检索范式的根本性缺陷。

sentences.en: Importantly, in a downstream literature review application, agents empowered with SciNet achieve a 25.3% improvement in review quality, highlighting the critical value of relation-aware retrieval for deepening scientific insights.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，在下游的文献综述应用中，配备 SciNet 的智能体在综述质量上取得了 25.3% 的提升，凸显了关系感知检索对于深化科学洞见的关键价值。

sentences.en: We publicly release SciNet at https://github.com/tsinghua-fib-lab/SciNet to support future research.
sentences.zh: 我们在 https://github.com/tsinghua-fib-lab/SciNet 公开发布 SciNet，以支持未来的研究。

title_en: SciPredict: Can LLMs Predict the Outcomes of Scientific Experiments in Natural Sciences?
title_zh: SciPredict：LLM 能否预测自然科学中科学实验的结果？

sentences.en: Accelerating scientific discovery requires the identification of which experiments would yield the best outcomes before committing resources to costly physical validation.
sentences.zh: 加速科学发现，需要在将资源投入到昂贵的物理验证之前，识别哪些实验会带来最好的结果。

sentences.en: While existing benchmarks evaluate LLMs on scientific knowledge and reasoning, their ability to predict experimental outcomes---a task where AI could significantly exceed human capabilities---remains largely underexplored.
sentences.zh: 尽管现有基准评估了 LLM 的科学知识与推理能力，但它们预测实验结果的能力——一项 AI 可能大幅超越人类的任务——在很大程度上仍未得到探索。

sentences.en: We introduce SciPredict, a benchmark comprising 405 tasks derived from recent empirical studies in 33 specialized sub-fields of physics, biology, and chemistry.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 SciPredict，一个由 405 个任务组成的基准，这些任务源自物理学、生物学与化学 33 个专业子领域的最新实证研究。

sentences.en: SciPredict addresses two critical questions: (a) *can LLMs predict the outcome of scientific experiments with sufficient accuracy?* and (b) *can such predictions be reliably used in the scientific research process?* Evaluations reveal fundamental limitations on both fronts.
sentences.zh: SciPredict 应对两个关键问题：(a) *LLM 能否以足够的准确率预测科学实验的结果？* (b) *这类预测能否被可靠地用于科学研究过程？* 评估揭示了这两个方面的根本局限。

sentences.en: Model accuracies are 14-26\% and human  expert performance is $\approx$20\%.
sentences.zh: 模型的准确率为 14-26\%，而人类专家的表现约为 $\approx$20\%。

sentences.en: Although some frontier models exceed human performance model accuracy is still far below what would enable reliable experimental guidance.
sentences.zh: 尽管一些前沿模型超过了人类表现，但模型准确率仍远低于能够提供可靠实验指导所需的水平。

sentences.en: Even within the limited performance, models fail to distinguish reliable predictions from unreliable ones, achieving only $\approx$20\% accuracy regardless of their confidence or whether they judge outcomes as predictable without physical experimentation.
sentences.zh: 即使在有限的性能范围内，模型也无法区分可靠的预测与不可靠的预测，无论其置信度如何，也不管它们是否认为结果无需物理实验即可预测，都仅取得 $\approx$20\% 的准确率。

sentences.en: Human experts, in contrast, demonstrate strong calibration: their accuracy increases from $\approx$5\% to $\approx$80\% as they deem outcomes more predictable without conducting the experiment.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，人类专家表现出很强的校准能力：随着他们认为结果无需实际开展实验即可预测的程度提高，其准确率从约 $\approx$5\% 上升到约 $\approx$80\%。

sentences.en: SciPredict establishes a rigorous framework demonstrating that superhuman performance in experimental science requires not just better predictions, but better awareness of prediction reliability.
sentences.zh: SciPredict 建立了一个严格的框架，表明实验科学中的超人表现不仅需要更好的预测，还需要对预测可靠性有更好的意识。

sentences.en: For reproducibility all our data and code are provided at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SciPredict-AI01.
sentences.zh: 为便于复现，我们已在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SciPredict-AI01 提供了全部数据与代码。

title_en: SciVideoBench: Benchmarking Scientific Video Reasoning in Large Multimodal Models
title_zh: SciVideoBench：在大型多模态模型中评估科学视频推理

sentences.en: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have achieved remarkable progress across various capabilities; however, complex video reasoning in the scientific domain remains a significant and challenging frontier.
sentences.zh: 大型多模态模型（LMM）已在多种能力上取得了显著进步；然而，科学领域中的复杂视频推理仍是一个重大而富有挑战性的前沿问题。

sentences.en: Current video benchmarks predominantly target general scenarios where perception/recognition is heavily relied on, while with relatively simple reasoning tasks, leading to saturation and thus failing to effectively evaluate advanced multimodal cognitive skills.
sentences.zh: 当前的视频基准主要面向依赖感知/识别的一般场景，其中的推理任务相对简单，导致结果饱和，因而无法有效评估高级的多模态认知技能。

sentences.en: To address this critical gap, we introduce SciVideoBench, a rigorous benchmark specifically designed to assess advanced video reasoning in scientific contexts.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一关键缺口，我们引入了 SciVideoBench，一个专门评估科学语境下高级视频推理的严格基准。

sentences.en: SciVideoBench consists of 1,000 carefully crafted multiple-choice questions derived from cutting-edge scientific experimental videos spanning over 25 specialized academic subjects and verified by a semi- automatic system.
sentences.zh: SciVideoBench 包含 1,000 个精心设计的多项选择题，源自覆盖超过 25 个专业学科的前沿科学实验视频，并经半自动化系统验证。

sentences.en: Each question demands sophisticated domain-specific knowledge, precise spatiotemporal perception, and intricate logical reasoning, effectively challenging models’ higher-order cognitive abilities.
sentences.zh: 每个问题都需要复杂的领域特定知识、精确的时空感知与缜密的逻辑推理，有效挑战模型的更高阶认知能力。

sentences.en: Our evaluation highlights significant performance deficits in state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source LMMs, including Gemini 2.5 Pro and Qwen2.5-VL, indicating substantial room for advancement in video reasoning capabilities.
sentences.zh: 我们的评估凸显了最先进的专有与开源 LMM（包括 Gemini 2.5 Pro 与 Qwen2.5-VL）在性能上的显著不足，表明视频推理能力还有很大的提升空间。

sentences.en: Detailed analyses of critical factors such as reasoning complexity and visual grounding provide valuable insights and clear direction for future developments in LMMs, driving the evolution of truly capable multimodal AI co-scientists.
sentences.zh: 对诸如推理复杂度与视觉接地等关键因素的详细分析，为 LMM 的未来发展提供了宝贵的洞见与明确方向，推动真正有能力的多模态 AI 共同科学家（co-scientists）的演进。

sentences.en: We hope SciVideoBench could fit the interests of the community and help to push the boundary of cutting-edge AI for border science.
sentences.zh: 我们希望 SciVideoBench 能够契合社区的兴趣，并帮助推动前沿 AI 在科学前沿领域不断突破界限。

title_en: SCNS: Continual Personalization of Diffusion Models via Submodular Concept Neuron Selection
title_zh: SCNS：通过子模概念神经元选择实现扩散模型的持续个性化

sentences.en: Custom diffusion models (CDMs) have demonstrated impressive success in visual personalization tasks by enabling the generation of user-specific concepts.
sentences.zh: 定制扩散模型（CDM）通过支持生成用户特定概念，在视觉个性化任务中展现出令人印象深刻的效果。

sentences.en: However, existing CDMs typically assume that personalized concepts are static and rely on costly model merging or sequential updates that are prone to catastrophic forgetting as new concepts are introduced.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的 CDM 通常假设个性化概念是静态的，并依赖昂贵的模型合并或顺序更新，后者在引入新概念时容易发生灾难性遗忘。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose a Submodular Concept Neuron Selection method (SCNS), to solve CDMs with continual personalized concepts, which formulates continual personalization as a constrained submodular optimization problem to select a minimal yet sufficient set of concept-specific neurons under diminishing returns.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，我们提出一种子模概念神经元选择方法（SCNS），以解决具有持续个性化概念的 CDM 问题，该方法将持续个性化形式化为一个带约束的子模优化问题，在收益递减的条件下选择最小且充分的概念特定神经元集。

sentences.en: SCNS combines a Facility Location-based coverage objective to suppress semantic redundancy, a Fisher-weighted risk proxy to protect previously learned concepts, and a cost-aware greedy rule to balance stability and plasticity with extreme sparsity.
sentences.zh: SCNS 结合了一种基于设施选址（Facility Location）的覆盖目标以抑制语义冗余、一种 Fisher 加权风险代理以保护先前学到的概念，以及一种成本感知的贪心规则，以在极端稀疏性下平衡稳定性与可塑性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that SCNS achieves state-of-the-art performance in image alignment and anti-forgetting, while enabling fusion-free continual personalization by modifying only 0.41% of the total parameters for each concept on average.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，SCNS 在图像对齐与抗遗忘方面达到了最先进的性能，同时通过平均每个概念仅修改总参数的 0.41%，实现了无需融合的持续个性化。

sentences.en: Our implementation is available at SCNS.
sentences.zh: 我们的实现可在 SCNS 获取。

title_en: SCoA: Revisiting Domain Generalized Object Detection with Style-Conditioned Adaptation
title_zh: SCoA：以风格条件化适配重新审视域泛化目标检测

sentences.en: Domain generalized object detection (DGOD) aims to train an object detector on a single source domain and generalize it to  unseen  target domains.
sentences.zh: 域泛化目标检测（DGOD）旨在单个源域上训练目标检测器，并将其泛化到未见过的目标域。

sentences.en: Recent advances in DGOD have increasingly exploited vision foundation models (VFMs) via parameter-efficient finetuning strategies.
sentences.zh: DGOD 的近期进展越来越多地通过参数高效微调策略利用视觉基础模型（VFM）。

sentences.en: However, existing approaches typically adapt VFMs with fixed, style-agnostic parameters, overlooking that different visual styles may induce distinct task discrepancies.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法通常以固定的、与风格无关的参数适配 VFM，忽略了不同视觉风格可能引发不同的任务差异。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose  SCoA, a novel  Style  Conditioned  Adaptation framework for dynamic, style-aware task compensation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 SCoA，一种新颖的风格条件化适配（Style Conditioned Adaptation）框架，用于动态、风格感知的任务补偿。

sentences.en: Specifically, we introduce a Spectral Style Modeling (SSM) module that preserves local style cues via a memory-based mechanism, enabling diverse style characterization from a single source domain.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们引入了一个谱风格建模（Spectral Style Modeling, SSM）模块，通过基于记忆的机制保留局部风格线索，从而能够从单一源域刻画多样的风格。

sentences.en: Conditioned on the extracted style signals, we design a Mixture-of-Tokens Adaptation (MTA) mechanism, which maintains multiple adaptation tokens and dynamically routes each sample to an optimal combination of tokens, thereby explicitly modeling style-dependent task mismatches.
sentences.zh: 基于提取到的风格信号，我们设计了一种 token 混合适配（Mixture-of-Tokens Adaptation, MTA）机制，它维护多个适配 token，并将每个样本动态路由到 token 的最优组合，从而显式建模风格相关的任务失配。

sentences.en: In addition, we propose a Style-Conditioned Query Refinement (SCQR) module that injects style information into object queries,  enabling a style-aware detection head.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出一个风格条件化查询精化（SCQR）模块，将风格信息注入对象查询，实现风格感知的检测头。

sentences.en: By jointly integrating these components, SCoA allows the model to follow style-specific adaptation trajectories, achieving effective and flexible task compensation for VFM-based DGOD.
sentences.zh: 通过联合整合这些组件，SCoA 使模型能够遵循风格特定的适配轨迹，为基于 VFM 的 DGOD 实现有效而灵活的任务补偿。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed SCoA  achieves state-of-the-art performance across two challenging scenarios.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，所提出的 SCoA 在两个具有挑战性的场景中取得了最先进的性能。

title_en: SCOPE and SCION: A Benchmark and an Auditable Reference Pipeline for Schema Induction and Fusion from Text
title_zh: SCOPE 与 SCION：面向文本模式归纳与融合的基准与可审计参考管线

sentences.en: Schema graphs are an upstream bottleneck of schema-grounded information extraction and knowledge graph construction, yet most extraction systems assume the schema is already available.
sentences.zh: 模式图是模式接地信息提取与知识图谱构建的上游瓶颈，然而大多数提取系统都假设模式已经可用。

sentences.en: We introduce SCOPE (Schema Construction and Ontology-induction Pipeline Evaluation), a train-text-only benchmark for corpus-to-schema induction and optional schema fusion from raw text, built from 24 public information extraction sources (15 RE and 9 EE) normalized into evaluation-only gold schema graphs; its core event-extraction target covers event types and within-event argument roles, with inter-event links reported separately.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 SCOPE（Schema Construction and Ontology-induction Pipeline Evaluation，模式构建与本体归纳管线评估），一个仅基于训练文本的基准，用于从原始文本中归纳语料到模式并进行可选的模式融合，它由 24 个公开信息提取来源（15 个关系抽取与 9 个事件抽取）构建，并归一化为仅用于评估的金标准模式图；其核心事件提取目标涵盖事件类型与事件内论元角色，事件间链接则单独报告。

sentences.en: We present SCION (Schema Construction and Induction with Ontology Normalization), an auditable reference pipeline rather than a new extraction architecture; it constructs candidate spaces from train text and restricts naming, merging, filtering, validation, and conservative fusion to candidate-linked evidence under strict JSON contracts.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 SCION（Schema Construction and Induction with Ontology Normalization，带本体归一化的模式构建与归纳），一个可审计的参考管线，而非新的提取架构；它从训练文本构建候选空间，并将命名、合并、过滤、验证与保守融合限制在与候选关联的证据上，同时遵循严格的 JSON 契约。

sentences.en: On the SCOPE core suite, SCION-lite attains the highest F1 among released source-schema references, Text2Onto-style, LLM-only, and matched extract-then-aggregate baselines under Literal, Fuzzy, Continuous, and Graph schema-graph metrics, while the compact open-model SCION-RL variant reduces reliance on proprietary LLM schema engineers.
sentences.zh: 在 SCOPE 核心套件上，SCION-lite 在 Literal、Fuzzy、Continuous 与 Graph 模式图指标下，相较于已发布的源模式参考、Text2Onto 式、纯 LLM 以及匹配的“先抽取后聚合”基线，取得了最高的 F1；而紧凑的开源模型变体 SCION-RL 则减少了对专有 LLM 模式工程师的依赖。

sentences.en: These results are reported against normalized typed-edge targets rather than as claims that induced schemas surpass human ontology design; the release includes evidence-linked outputs, parse/fallback logs, candidate retention/merging logs, run manifests, code, and benchmark packages at [https://github.com/wandugu/paper_scion](https://github.com/wandugu/paper_scion).
sentences.zh: 这些结果是相对于归一化的带类型边目标报告的，而非声称归纳出的模式超越人类本体设计；本次发布包含证据关联输出、解析/回退日志、候选保留/合并日志、运行清单、代码与基准包，见 https://github.com/wandugu/paper_scion。

title_en: SCOPE: Evolving Symbolic World for Planning in Open-Ended Environments
title_zh: SCOPE：面向开放环境规划的演化符号世界

sentences.en: Recent works have explored integrating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with classical planners that rely on symbolic representations of planning problem to generate long-horizon plans for complex embodied tasks.
sentences.zh: 近期工作探索了将视觉-语言模型（VLM）与依赖规划问题符号表示的经典规划器相结合，以针对复杂具身任务生成长视界规划。

sentences.en: However, in open-ended environments, these symbolic representations obtained from perception are often incomplete, leading to suboptimal performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，在开放环境中，这些从感知中获得的符号表示往往不完整，导致性能欠佳。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce SCOPE, a self-adaptive symbolic planning framework that supports refining action plans and evolving the symbolic world—the symbolic representations of open-ended environments.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们引入了 SCOPE，一个自适应符号规划框架，支持精化行动规划并演化符号世界——即开放环境的符号表示。

sentences.en: SCOPE comprises two synergistic modules: a Symbolic Execution Simulator (SESim) that conducts symbolic validation and real execution of action plans, leveraging the feedback to refine the plans and evolve the symbolic world; and a Self-Adaptive Symbolic Memory (SASMem) that further distills feedback into evolving symbolic knowledge to enhance long-horizon planning and modeling of the symbolic world.
sentences.zh: SCOPE 由两个协同模块组成：符号执行模拟器（SESim），对行动规划进行符号验证与实际执行，并利用反馈来精化规划与演化符号世界；以及自适应符号记忆（SASMem），进一步将反馈提炼为演化的符号知识，以增强长视界规划与对符号世界的建模。

sentences.en: Experiments in open-ended environments show that SCOPE significantly improves the completeness of the symbolic world, the success rate of plans under environment perturbations, and cross-task grounding and adaptability across diverse embodied scenarios.
sentences.zh: 开放环境中的实验表明，SCOPE 显著提升了符号世界的完整性、环境扰动下规划的成功率，以及跨多样具身场景的跨任务接地与适应性。

title_en: SCOPE: Selective Conformal Optimized Pairwise LLM Judging
title_zh: SCOPE：选择性共形优化的成对 LLM 评判

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as scalable judges in pairwise evaluation, but they remain prone to miscalibration and biases.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作成对评估中的可扩展评判者，但它们仍容易出现错误校准与偏见。

sentences.en: We propose SCOPE (Selective Conformal Optimized Pairwise Evaluation), a framework that calibrates an acceptance threshold so that, under exchangeability, the error rate among non-abstained judgments is at most a user-specified level $\alpha$.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 SCOPE（Selective Conformal Optimized Pairwise Evaluation，选择性共形优化的成对评估），一个校准接受阈值的框架，使得在可交换性（exchangeability）下，非弃权判断中的错误率至多为用户指定的水平 $\alpha$。

sentences.en: To supply SCOPE with a bias-neutral uncertainty signal, we introduce Bidirectional Preference Entropy (BPE), which queries the judge under both response positions and converts the order-averaged preference probability into an entropy-based score.
sentences.zh: 为向 SCOPE 提供偏置中性的不确定性信号，我们引入了双向偏好熵（Bidirectional Preference Entropy, BPE），它在两种响应位置下查询评判者，并将顺序平均后的偏好概率转换为基于熵的得分。

sentences.en: Across various pairwise judging benchmarks, BPE outperforms standard confidence proxies in calibration and discrimination, while SCOPE consistently satisfies the target risk bound (empirical FDR $\approx 0.097$--$0.099$ at $\alpha=0.10$) and retains substantial coverage.
sentences.zh: 在多种成对评判基准上，BPE 在校准与区分度方面优于标准置信度代理，而 SCOPE 始终满足目标风险界（在 $\alpha=0.10$ 时经验 FDR 约为 $\approx 0.097$–$0.099$），并保持相当大的覆盖率。

sentences.en: Compared to vanilla baselines, SCOPE accepts up to $2.4\times$ more judgments under the same risk constraint, demonstrating that BPE enables reliable and high-coverage LLM-based evaluation.
sentences.zh: 与基础基线相比，SCOPE 在同一风险约束下可多接受最多 $2.4\times$ 的判断，表明 BPE 能够实现可靠且高覆盖率的基于 LLM 的评估。

title_en: Score Based Error Correcting Code Decoder
title_zh: 基于分数的纠错码解码器

sentences.en: Error-correcting codes enable reliable communication, yet practical soft decoding remains challenging across code families and block lengths.
sentences.zh: 纠错码能够实现可靠的通信，然而实用的软解码在各种码族与块长度上仍具挑战性。

sentences.en: We propose SB-ECC, a score-based decoder that casts decoding as continuous-time denoising.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 SB-ECC，一个基于分数的解码器，将解码视为连续时间去噪。

sentences.en: A neural denoiser defines a probability-flow ordinary differential equation (ODE) that iteratively updates the noisy channel observation toward a valid codeword, guided by parity constraints.
sentences.zh: 一个神经去噪器定义一个概率流常微分方程组（ODE），它在奇偶校验约束的引导下，迭代式地将带噪信道观测更新为一个有效码字。

sentences.en: The model is trained across noise levels without time/SNR conditioning, enabling inference without SNR estimation and supporting a direct latency--accuracy trade-off controlled by the ODE solver budget.
sentences.zh: 该模型在跨噪声水平上训练，无需时间/SNR 条件，从而允许无需 SNR 估计的推理，并支持由 ODE 求解器预算控制的延迟-准确率权衡。

sentences.en: We use the raw signed channel observation as input for learning a continuous denoising field.
sentences.zh: 我们使用原始带符号的信道观测作为输入，以学习一个连续去噪场。

sentences.en: Across $42$ code/SNR settings, SB-ECC achieves the best BER in $39/42$ entries, with an average SNR gain of $0.17$\,dB and a maximum gain of $0.46$\,dB over the strongest competing baseline, we showed that swapping the solver from Euler to DPM preserves $-\ln(\mathrm{BER})$ while reducing end-to-end decoding time by $8.86\%$ on average (up to $12.82\%$).
sentences.zh: 在 $42$ 个码/SNR 设定中，SB-ECC 在 $39/42$ 项中取得了最佳 BER，相比最强的竞争基线平均 SNR 增益为 $0.17$\,dB、最大增益为 $0.46$\,dB；我们还表明，将求解器从 Euler 换成 DPM，在保持 $\\ln(\mathrm{BER})$ 不变的同时，将端到端解码时间平均减少了 $8.86\%$（最高达 $12.82\%$）。

title_en: Score Correction for Generative Models with Probabilistic Constraints
title_zh: 带概率约束的生成模型的分数校正

sentences.en: We introduce DualScore, a framework for correcting  score functions so that score-based generative models satisfy probabilistic constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 DualScore，一个校正分数函数的框架，使基于分数的生成模型满足概率约束。

sentences.en: These constraints are specified through the marginal distribution of a stochastic transformation of the modeled variable.
sentences.zh: 这些约束通过被建模变量的一个随机变换的边际分布来指定。

sentences.en: We formulate this as a constrained KL-minimization problem, and optimize its dual, parameterizing the infinite-dimensional dual variable with a neural network.
sentences.zh: 我们将其形式化为一个带约束的 KL 最小化问题，并优化其对偶形式，用神经网络参数化这个无限维的对偶变量。

sentences.en: This yields an additive correction to the original score function that can be used directly for sampling via stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics or reverse diffusion sampling, without modifying the base model.
sentences.zh: 这产生一个对原始分数函数的加性校正，它可以直接用于通过随机梯度 Langevin 动力学或反向扩散采样进行采样，而无需修改基础模型。

sentences.en: We evaluate DualScore on synthetic tasks and two real-world applications: regularized nonparametric maximum likelihood estimation and the incorporation of class-level constraints such as fairness into pretrained image diffusion models.
sentences.zh: 我们在合成任务与两个现实世界应用上评估了 DualScore：正则化非参数极大似然估计，以及在预训练图像扩散模型中融入诸如公平性之类的类级约束。

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Score-Repellent Monte Carlo: Toward Efficient Non-Markovian Sampler with Constant Memory in General State Spaces
title_zh: 分数排斥蒙特卡洛：迈向通用状态空间中具有恒定内存的高效非马尔可夫采样器

sentences.en: History-dependent sampling can reduce long-run Monte Carlo variance by discouraging redundant revisits, but existing schemes typically encode history through empirical measure on finite state spaces, which is infeasible in high-dimensional discrete configuration spaces or ill-posed in continuous domains.
sentences.zh: 依赖历史的采样可以通过抑制冗余回访来降低长期蒙特卡洛方差，但现有方案通常通过有限状态空间上的经验测度对历史进行编码，在高维离散构型空间中不可行，在连续域中则是不适定的。

sentences.en: We propose *Score-Repellent Monte Carlo* (SRMC) framework that summarizes trajectory history by a fixed, $d$-dimensional running average of score evaluations and converts it into a history-dependent surrogate target via an exponential *score tilt*.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了*分数排斥蒙特卡洛*（Score-Repellent Monte Carlo, SRMC）框架，通过分数评估的固定 $d$-维滑动平均来概括轨迹历史，并通过指数*分数倾斜*（score tilt）将其转化为一个依赖历史的替代目标。

sentences.en: The resulting surrogate family is normalization-free in the standard MCMC sense, yielding a generic wrapper: at each iteration, any standard base kernel designed for the target $\pi$ can be run on the current surrogate $\pi_{\theta_n}$ while updating the history online.
sentences.zh: 由此产生的替代分布族在标准 MCMC 意义上是无需归一化的，从而产生一个通用包装器：在每次迭代中，任何为目标 $\pi$ 设计的标准基础核都可以运行于当前替代目标 $\pi_{\theta_n}$ 之上，同时在线更新历史。

sentences.en: We analyze the coupled evolution of any estimator and the history recursion using stochastic approximation with controlled Markovian noise, establishing almost sure convergence and a joint central limit theorem.
sentences.zh: 我们利用带受控马尔可夫噪声的随机逼近，分析任意估计器与历史递归的耦合演化，建立了几乎必然收敛与一个联合中心极限定理。

sentences.en: We identify regimes where the asymptotic covariance decreases as the repellence strength $\alpha$ increases, exhibiting a scaling of $O(1/\alpha)$, reproducing near-zero variance effect but now on general state spaces with constant memory.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出这样的机制：随着排斥强度 $\alpha$ 增大，渐近协方差减小，呈现 $O(1/\alpha)$ 的缩放，重现近零方差效应，但现在是在具有恒定内存的通用状态空间上。

sentences.en: Empirical results across continuous targets and discrete energy-based models demonstrate that SRMC delivers notable improvements in estimator variance and in effectively covering modes in Gaussian mixtures, all while retaining $O(d)$ memory usage and minimal overhead per iteration.
sentences.zh: 跨连续目标与离散能量模型的实证结果表明，SRMC 在估计器方差方面带来了显著改进，并能有效覆盖高斯混合中的模式，同时保持 $O(d)$ 的内存使用与每迭代最小的开销。

title_en: SCORE: A Unified Framework for Overshoot Refund in Online FDR Control
title_zh: SCORE：在线 FDR 控制中过冲退还的统一框架

sentences.en: We propose a unified framework to enhance the power of online multiple hypothesis testing procedures based on $e$-values.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个统一框架，以增强基于 $e$-值的在线多重假设检验过程的功效。

sentences.en: While $e$-value-based methods offer robust online False Discovery Rate (FDR) control under minimal assumptions, they often suffer from power loss by discarding evidence that exceeds the rejection threshold.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于 $e$-值的方法在最少假设下提供了稳健的在线 FDR（错误发现率）控制，但它们往往因丢弃超过拒绝阈值的证据而损失功效。

sentences.en: We address this inefficiency via the \textbf{S}equential \textbf{C}ontrol with \textbf{O}vershoot \textbf{R}efund for \textbf{E}-values (SCORE) framework, which leverages the inequality $\mathbb{I}(y \ge 1)
sentences.zh: 我们通过 SCORE（Sequential Control with Overshoot Refund for E-values，面向 $e$-值的带过冲退还的顺序控制）框架来解决这一低效问题，该框架利用不等式 $\mathbb{I}(y \ge 1)$

sentences.en: \le y - (y-1)_+$, valid for all $y\ge 0$, to reclaim this otherwise ``wasted'' evidence.
sentences.zh: $\le y - (y-1)_+$，该式对所有 $y\ge 0$ 成立，从而回收这部分原本“被浪费”的证据。

sentences.en: This simple yet powerful insight yields a unified principle for improving a broad class of online testing algorithms.
sentences.zh: 这一简单却强大的洞见，为改进一大类在线检验算法提供了一个统一原则。

sentences.en: Building on this framework, we develop SCORE-enhanced versions of several state-of-the-art procedures, including SCORE-LOND, SCORE-LORD, and SCORE-SAFFRON, all of which strictly dominate their original counterparts while preserving valid finite-sample FDR control.
sentences.zh: 基于该框架，我们开发了若干最先进程序的 SCORE 增强版本，包括 SCORE-LOND、SCORE-LORD 与 SCORE-SAFFRON，它们都严格优于其原始对应版本，同时保持有效的有限样本 FDR 控制。

sentences.en: Furthermore, under mild assumptions, SCORE permits retroactive updates of alpha‑wealth by using the latest decision twice: first to determine its reward or loss, and then to refresh past wealth.
sentences.zh: 此外，在温和的假设下，SCORE 允许通过将最新决策使用两次来对 alpha-wealth 进行追溯更新：第一次用于确定其奖励或损失，然后用于刷新过去的财富。

sentences.en: Such a mechanism enables more aggressive testing strategies while maintaining valid FDR control, thereby further improving statistical power.
sentences.zh: 这种机制能够在保持有效 FDR 控制的同时支持更具攻击性的检验策略，从而进一步提高统计功效。

sentences.en: The effectiveness of the proposed methods is validated through extensive simulation and real-data experiments.
sentences.zh: 所提方法的有效性通过大量的仿真与真实数据实验得到了验证。

title_en: ScoreMatchingRiesz: Score Matching for Debiased Machine Learning and Policy Path Estimation
title_zh: ScoreMatchingRiesz：用于去偏机器学习与策略路径估计的分数匹配

sentences.en: We propose \emph{ScoreMatchingRiesz}, a family of Riesz representer estimators based on score matching.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 \emph{ScoreMatchingRiesz}，一族基于分数匹配的 Riesz 表示子估计器。

sentences.en: The Riesz representer is a key nuisance component in debiased machine learning, enabling $\sqrt{n}$-consistent and asymptotically efficient estimation of causal and structural targets via Neyman-orthogonal scores.
sentences.zh: Riesz 表示子是去偏机器学习中的一个关键干扰（nuisance）分量，它通过 Neyman 正交分数实现因果目标与结构目标的 $\sqrt{n}$-一致且渐近有效的估计。

sentences.en: We formulate Riesz representer estimation as a score estimation problem.
sentences.zh: 我们将 Riesz 表示子估计形式化为一个分数估计问题。

sentences.en: This perspective stabilizes representer estimation by allowing us to leverage denoising score matching and telescoping density ratio estimation.
sentences.zh: 这一视角通过使我们能够利用去噪分数匹配与望远镜式密度比估计，稳定了表示子估计。

sentences.en: We also introduce the policy path, a parameter that captures how policy effects evolve under continuous treatments.
sentences.zh: 我们还引入了策略路径（policy path），一个刻画连续治疗下策略效应如何演化的参数。

sentences.en: We show that the policy path can be estimated via score matching by smoothly connecting average marginal effect (AME) and average policy effect (APE) estimation, which improves the interpretability of policy effects.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，通过平滑地连接平均边际效应（AME）与平均策略效应（APE）估计，可以经由分数匹配来估计策略路径，从而提高策略效应的可解释性。

sentences.en: The replication code is available in the genriesz library.
sentences.zh: 复现代码可在 genriesz 库中获取。

title_en: ScoreMix: Synthetic Data Generation by Score Composition in Diffusion Models Improves Recognition
title_zh: ScoreMix：通过扩散模型中的分数组合进行合成数据生成以改进识别

sentences.en: Synthetic data generation is increasingly used in machine learning for **training and data augmentation**.
sentences.zh: 合成数据生成越来越多地用于机器学习中的**训练与数据增强**。

sentences.en: Yet, many current strategies rely on external foundation models or datasets, which can be restricted by policy or legal constraints, especially for sensitive modalities such as human face images and videos.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多当前策略依赖外部基础模型或数据集，这可能受到政策或法律约束的限制，尤其是对于人脸图像与视频等敏感模态。

sentences.en: We propose **ScoreMix**, a **self-contained data augmentation** method to boost recognition performance by leveraging score compositionality in class-conditioned diffusion models.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 **ScoreMix**，一种**自包含的数据增强**方法，通过在类条件扩散模型中利用分数可组合性来提升识别性能。

sentences.en: ScoreMix mixes class-conditioned scores along reverse diffusion trajectories, yielding domain-specific hard augmentations without external resources.
sentences.zh: ScoreMix 沿反向扩散轨迹混合类条件分数，无需外部资源即可产生领域特定的困难增强。

sentences.en: We systematically study class-selection strategies and find that mixing classes that are distant in the discriminator embedding space yields larger gains, providing **up to 3\% additional average improvement across benchmarks** over proximity-based selection.
sentences.zh: 我们系统地研究了类别选择策略，发现混合判别器嵌入空间中距离较远的类别能带来更大的提升，相比基于邻近度的选择，**跨基准平均额外提高最多 3\%**。

sentences.en: Interestingly, we observe that learned condition and embedding spaces are largely uncorrelated under standard alignment metrics, and that condition-space distances are weakly correlated to downstream gains.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我们观察到，在标准对齐度量下，学习到的条件空间与嵌入空间在很大程度上是不相关的，而条件空间距离与下游增益仅弱相关。

sentences.en: Across **8 public face recognition benchmarks**, ScoreMix improves accuracy by **up to 7 percentage points** without hyperparameter search, highlighting robustness and practicality.
sentences.zh: 在**8 个公开的人脸识别基准**上，ScoreMix 在无需超参数搜索的情况下将准确率提升了**最多 7 个百分点**，凸显了其稳健性与实用性。

sentences.en: Project page: https://parsa-ra.github.io/scoremix/ .
sentences.zh: 项目主页：https://parsa-ra.github.io/scoremix/。

title_en: Scout Before You Attend: Sketch-and-Walk Sparse Attention for Efficient LLM Inference
title_zh: 在关注之前先侦察：面向高效 LLM 推理的草绘-漫步稀疏注意力

sentences.en: Self-attention dominates the computational and memory cost of long-context LLM inference across both prefill and decode phases.
sentences.zh: 注意力力主导了长上下文 LLM 推理在前缀填充（prefill）与解码两个阶段的计算与内存成本。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we introduce **Sketch\&Walk** Attention, a training-free sparse attention method that determines sparsity with lightweight sketches and deterministic walk.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们引入了 **Sketch\&Walk** 注意力，一种无需训练的稀疏注意力方法，利用轻量级草绘（sketch）与确定性漫步（walk）来确定稀疏性。

sentences.en: Sketch\&Walk applies Hadamard sketching to get inexpensive approximations of attention scores, then aggregates these estimates across layers via a walk mechanism that captures attention influence beyond direct interactions between tokens.
sentences.zh: Sketch\&Walk 应用 Hadamard 草绘来获得注意力分数的廉价近似，然后通过一种漫步机制在层间聚合这些估计，以捕捉超出 token 间直接交互的注意力影响。

sentences.en: The accumulated walk scores are used to select top-$k$ attention blocks, enabling dynamic sparsity with a single training-free algorithm that applies uniformly to both the prefill and decode phases, together with custom sparse attention kernels.
sentences.zh: 累积的漫步分数用于选择 top-$k$ 注意力块，从而通过一个统一适用于前缀填充与解码两个阶段的单一免训练算法实现动态稀疏性，并配有定制的稀疏注意力核心。

sentences.en: Across a wide range of models and tasks, Sketch\&Walk maintains near-lossless accuracy at 20\% attention density and can slightly outperform dense attention in some settings, while achieving up to $4.7\times$ end-to-end attention speedup over FlashAttention-2.
sentences.zh: 在广泛的模型与任务中，Sketch\&Walk 在 20\% 注意力密度下保持近乎无损的准确率，在某些设定下甚至能略微超越稠密注意力，同时相比 FlashAttention-2 实现了高达 $4.7\times$ 的端到端注意力加速。

title_en: SCOUT: Active Information Foraging for Long-Text Understanding with Decoupled Epistemic States
title_zh: SCOUT：基于解耦认知状态的主动信息觅食用于长文本理解

sentences.en: Long-Text Understanding (LTU) at million-token scale requires balancing reasoning fidelity with computational efficiency.
sentences.zh: 百万 token 规模的长文本理解（LTU）需要在推理保真度与计算效率之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: Frontier long-context LLMs can process millions of token contexts end-to-end, but they suffer from high token consumption and attention dilution.
sentences.zh: 前沿长上下文 LLM 可以端到端处理数百万 token 的上下文，但它们遭受高 token 消耗与注意力稀释的问题。

sentences.en: In parallel, specialized LTU agents often sacrifice fidelity through task-agnostic abstractions like graph construction or indexing.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，专门的 LTU 智能体往往通过图构建或索引等与任务无关的抽象来牺牲保真度。

sentences.en: We identify a key insight for LTU: query-relevant information is typically sparse relative to the full document, so effective reasoning should rely on a query-sufficient subset rather than the entire context.
sentences.zh: 我们为 LTU 识别出一个关键洞见：查询相关信息相对于整篇文档通常是稀疏的，因此有效的推理应当依赖一个查询充分（query-sufficient）的子集，而非整个上下文。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose SCOUT, a new paradigm for LTU that **shifts from passive processing to active information foraging**.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 SCOUT，一种 LTU 新范式，**从被动处理转向主动信息觅食**。

sentences.en: It treats the document as an explorable environment and answers from a compact, provenance-grounded epistemic state.
sentences.zh: 它将文档视为一个可探索的环境，并从紧凑的、有来源依据（provenance-grounded）的认知状态中作答。

sentences.en: Guided by state-level gap diagnosis, SCOUT adaptively alternates between coarse-to-fine exploration and anchored state updates that progressively *contract* its epistemic state toward query sufficiency.
sentences.zh: 在状态级差距诊断的引导下，SCOUT 自适应地在“由粗到细的探索”与“锚定状态更新”之间交替，逐步将其认知状态*收缩*到查询充分性。

sentences.en: Experiments show that SCOUT matches state-of-the-art proprietary models while reducing token consumption by up to 8 times.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，SCOUT 在将 token 消耗降低最多 8 倍的同时，达到了与最先进专有模型相当的性能。

sentences.en: Moreover, SCOUT remains stable as context length scales, substantially alleviating the practical cost--capability trade-off in long-context reasoning.
sentences.zh: 此外，随着上下文长度扩展，SCOUT 保持稳定，显著缓解了长上下文推理中的实际成本-能力权衡。

sentences.en: Resources are available at our [Project Page](https://xavierzhang2002.github.io/scout-page/).
sentences.zh: 资源可在我们的项目主页 https://xavierzhang2002.github.io/scout-page/ 获取。

title_en: SCOUT: Cyclic Causal Discovery Under Soft Interventions with Unknown Targets
title_zh: SCOUT：在目标未知的软干预下进行循环因果发现

sentences.en: Learning causal relationships between variables from data is a fundamental research area with many applications across disciplines.
sentences.zh: 从数据中学习变量之间的因果关系是一个基础研究领域，在多个学科中都有广泛应用。

sentences.en: Most of the existing causal discovery algorithms rely on the assumptions that (i) the underlying system is acyclic, (ii) the exogenous noise variables are Gaussian, and (iii) that the intervention targets for the data generating experiments are known.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有因果发现算法依赖于以下假设：(i) 潜在系统是无环的，(ii) 外生噪声变量是高斯分布的，以及 (iii) 生成实验数据的干预目标是已知的。

sentences.en: While these assumptions simplify the analysis, they are violated in real-life systems.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些假设简化了分析，但它们在现实系统中往往被违反。

sentences.en: Most existing methods that address these issues either assume the underlying model is linear or are constrained to operate in limited interventional settings.
sentences.zh: 大多数处理这些问题的现有方法要么假设潜在模型是线性的，要么被限制在有限的干预设定中运行。

sentences.en: To that end, we propose SCOUT, a novel causal discovery framework to learn nonlinear causal cyclic relationships from soft interventional data with unknown targets.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出了 SCOUT，一个新颖的因果发现框架，用于从目标未知的软干预数据中学习非线性循环因果关系。

sentences.en: Our main approach maximizes the data log-likelihood to recover the graph structure, using two normalizing-flow architectures—contractive residual flows and neural spline flows.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要方法通过最大化数据对数似然来恢复图结构，使用两种归一化流架构——收缩残差流与神经样条流。

sentences.en: By conducting experiments on synthetic and real-world data, we show that SCOUT outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both causal graph and unknown target recovery across various interventional and noise settings.
sentences.zh: 通过在合成与真实数据上进行实验，我们表明 SCOUT 在多种干预与噪声设定下，无论在因果图恢复还是未知目标恢复方面都优于最先进的方法。

title_en: ScreenParse: Moving Beyond Sparse Grounding with Complete Screen Parsing Supervision
title_zh: ScreenParse：以完整的屏幕解析监督超越稀疏接地

sentences.en: Modern computer-use agents (CUA) must perceive a screen as a structured state, what elements are visible, where they are, and what text they contain, before they can reliably ground instructions and act.
sentences.zh: 现代计算机使用智能体（CUA）必须将屏幕感知为一种结构化状态——有哪些元素可见、它们在何处、包含什么文本——之后才能可靠地接地指令并采取行动。

sentences.en: Yet, most available grounding datasets provide sparse supervision, with *insufficient* and *low-diversity* labels that annotate only a small subset of task-relevant elements per screen, which limits both coverage and generalization; moreover, practical deployment requires efficiency to enable low-latency, on-device use.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数可用的接地数据集提供稀疏监督，带有*不足*且*低多样性*的标签，每屏只标注任务相关元素的一小部分子集，这限制了覆盖范围与泛化能力；此外，实际部署还需要效率，以实现低延迟的端侧使用。

sentences.en: We introduce **ScreenParse**, a large-scale dataset for *complete* screen parsing, with dense annotations of all visible UI elements (boxes, 55-class types, and text) across 771K web screenshots (21M elements).
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 **ScreenParse**，一个用于*完整*屏幕解析的大规模数据集，对 771K 张网页截图中所有可见 UI 元素（框、55 类类型与文本）进行密集标注，共 2100 万个元素。

sentences.en: ScreenParse is generated by **Webshot**, an automated, scalable pipeline that renders diverse urls, extracts annotations and applies VLM-based relabeling and quality filtering.
sentences.zh: ScreenParse 由 **Webshot** 生成，这是一个自动化、可扩展的管线，渲染多样的 URL、提取标注，并应用基于 VLM 的重新标注与质量过滤。

sentences.en: Using ScreenParse, we train **ScreenVLM**, a compact, 316M-parameter vision language model (VLM) that decodes a compact ScreenTag markup representation with a structure-aware loss that upweights structure-critical tokens.
sentences.zh: 利用 ScreenParse，我们训练了 **ScreenVLM**，一个紧凑的、3.16 亿参数的视觉语言模型（VLM），它解码一种紧凑的 ScreenTag 标记表示，并采用一种结构感知损失，加大结构关键 token 的权重。

sentences.en: ScreenVLM substantially outperforms much larger foundation VLMs on dense parsing (e.g., 0.592 vs. 0.294 PageIoU on ScreenParse) and shows strong transfer to public benchmarks.
sentences.zh: ScreenVLM 在密集解析方面大幅优于大得多的基础 VLM（例如在 ScreenParse 上 PageIoU 为 0.592 对 0.294），并展现出对公开基准的强迁移能力。

sentences.en: Moreover, finetuning foundation VLMs on ScreenParse consistently improves their grounding performance, suggesting that dense screen supervision provides transferable structural priors for UI understanding.
sentences.zh: 此外，在 ScreenParse 上微调基础 VLM 会持续改进它们的接地性能，这表明密集的屏幕监督为 UI 理解提供了可迁移的结构先验。

sentences.en: The dataset, model and code will be made publicly available.
sentences.zh: 数据集、模型与代码将公开提供。

title_en: SCRWKV: Ultra-Compact Structure-Calibrated Vision-RWKV for Topological Crack Segmentation
title_zh: SCRWKV：用于拓扑裂缝分割的超紧凑结构校准视觉 RWKV

sentences.en: Achieving pixel-level accurate segmentation of structural cracks across diverse scenarios remains a formidable challenge.
sentences.zh: 在不同场景下实现结构裂缝的像素级精确分割仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。

sentences.en: Existing methods face significant bottlenecks in balancing crack topology modeling with computational efficiency, often failing to reconcile high segmentation quality with low resource demands.
sentences.zh: 现有方法在平衡裂缝拓扑建模与计算效率方面面临显著瓶颈，往往难以兼顾高分割质量与低资源需求。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose the Ultra-Compact Structure-Calibrated Vision RWKV (SCRWKV), a network that achieves high-precision modeling via a novel Structure-Field Encoder (SFE) backbone while maintaining linear complexity.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，我们提出了超紧凑结构校准视觉 RWKV（SCRWKV），一个通过新颖的结构场编码器（Structure-Field Encoder, SFE）主干实现高精度建模、同时保持线性复杂度的网络。

sentences.en: The SFE integrates the Adaptive Multi-scale Cascaded Modulator (AMCM) to enhance texture representation and utilizes the Structure-Calibrated Insight Unit (SCIU) as its core engine.
sentences.zh: SFE 集成自适应多尺度级联调制器（AMCM）以增强纹理表示，并采用结构校准洞察单元（SCIU）作为其核心引擎。

sentences.en: Specifically, the SCIU employs the Geometry-guided Bidirectional Structure Transformation (GBST) to capture topological correlations and integrates the Dynamic Self-Calibrating Decay (DSCD) into Dy-WKV to suppress noise propagation.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，SCIU 采用几何引导的双向结构变换（GBST）来捕捉拓扑相关性，并将动态自校准衰减（DSCD）集成进 Dy-WKV 以抑制噪声传播。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce a lightweight Cross-Scale Harmonic Fusion (CSHF) decoder to achieve precise feature aggregation.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入一个轻量级的跨尺度谐波融合（CSHF）解码器，以实现精确的特征聚合。

sentences.en: Systematic evaluations on multiple benchmarks characterized by complex textures and severe interference demonstrate that SCRWKV, with only 1.22M parameters, significantly outperforms SOTA methods.
sentences.zh: 在多个以复杂纹理与严重干扰为特征的基准上的系统性评估表明，仅凭 1.22M 参数的 SCRWKV 便显著优于最先进（SOTA）方法。

sentences.en: Achieving an F1 score of 0.8428 and mIoU of 0.8512 on the TUT dataset, the model confirms its robust potential for efficient real-world deployment.
sentences.zh: 该模型在 TUT 数据集上取得 0.8428 的 F1 分数与 0.8512 的 mIoU，确认了其在高效现实世界部署方面的稳健潜力。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/zhxhzy/SCRWKV.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/zhxhzy/SCRWKV 获取。
